notes.title: Play fair, Brave Ones!
notes.content: [p]Brave Ones![/p][p]A bug was recently discovered in the game: the first-day reward in the cyclic part of the Monthly Gift Marathon (which included gold coins) could be claimed an unlimited number of times. We thoroughly checked all cases and took measures to restore balance in the game:[/p][p]• Accounts of players who abused this bug (hundreds of thousands of times) and immediately spent the obtained currency in large volumes will be blocked.[/p][p]• In some cases, gold coins obtained through this bug will be deducted from player accounts.[/p][p]• Players who claimed the reward only once per day will not be affected by these measures.[/p][p]All actions are aimed at preserving fair gameplay and equal conditions for all participants. We remind you that exploiting game bugs or errors for personal gain is strictly prohibited and may result in account suspension.[/p]

notes.title: Opening of the Hall of Fame Update
notes.content:
[p]Brave Ones![/p][p]The world of Singoru never stands still! On the horizon are new challenges, fresh opportunities, and even more reasons to prove yourself. And the greatest of these will be the opening of the [b]Hall of Fame[/b] — a place where only the best of the best will remain. It is time to see what has changed in Singoru — we are sure that each of you will find something for yourself![/p][hr][/hr][h3]New Building: Hall of Fame[/h3][p]A historic event has taken place in our town!
The [b]Hall of Fame[/b] has been solemnly opened — a place where the names of the greatest Braves are immortalized. Now you can prove to everyone that your name shines brighter than all among the legends![/p][p]The Hall of Fame takes into account much more than just profile level. The ranking system reflects everything that makes a player a true legend: player progress, victories over bosses, portal discoveries, and acquired equipment. To have your name appear in the Hall of Fame, it is enough to log in after the update — because only the achievements of active players are counted.[/p][p]As we mentioned earlier in our diaries, over time the Hall of Fame will develop, gain new features, and become more and more interesting. Ahead await seasons and leagues, new stages, and of course, rewards. For being in the lead is already an achievement, and receiving a worthy reward for it is doubly pleasant.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Hall of Fame Rankings[/h3][p][b]Masters of Progress — Profile Level[/b]
The higher your current profile level, the higher your position in the overall list. The metric is simple and clear: as the profile level grows, the place in the Hall of Fame also rises.[/p][p][b]Titan Hunters — Boss Kills[/b]
Glory points are awarded for victories over bosses and scale based on:[/p][list][*][p]the difficulty of the location (the harder the location, the more points);[/p][/*][*][p]the order of the boss in the location (defeating the final boss gives more points than the first).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Lords of Aether — Portal Discoveries[/b]
Ranking for opening aether portals:[/p][list][*][p]points are awarded for opening portals;[/p][/*][*][p]time-limited portals, opened with Prisms of Eternity, bring more ranking points.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Forges of Fate — Equipment Acquisition[/b]
Points are awarded for obtaining equipment items from various sources:[/p][list][*][p]the higher the rarity and star rating of the item, the more points you receive;[/p][/*][*][p]the method of obtaining equipment also affects the number of points.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Clans[/b]
A separate section has already been reserved and will appear in future updates.[/p][p]⚠️ Important: Titan Hunter and Lord of Aether rankings will not take into account past merits in the world of Singoru.[/p][p]For all Braves the conditions will be equal: no one will gain an advantage from old merits, and the final place in the ranking will depend only on your actions after the opening of the Hall of Fame.
Now everything is in your hands — prove your mastery and earn the right to be called the best Titan Hunter or try on the crown of the Lord of Aether![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Adjustments to Unholy Barrier and Throwing Disk Evolutions[/h3][p]An error was discovered in which modifiers from passive abilities were not applied to the evolutions [b]“You Shall Not Pass!”[/b] and [b]“Queen’s Song”[/b] if the player learned these passive abilities after obtaining the evolutions themselves.[/p][p]Now the system works correctly:[/p][list][*][p]If the evolution was obtained earlier and the passive ability that affects this evolution was learned later, the modifiers will still be applied. The evolutions [b]“You Shall Not Pass!”[/b] and [b]“Queen’s Song”[/b] will receive bonuses to damage, area of effect, projectile speed, and so on.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Simplification of Early Stages of the Game[/h3][p]Health and Attack values of monsters have been reduced in several Normal mode locations:[/p][list][*][p]Forest (from Easy to Hell difficulties),[/p][/*][*][p]Laboratory (from Easy to Hell difficulties),[/p][/*][*][p]Graveyard (from Easy to Hard difficulties),[/p][/*][*][p]Mycelium (Easy difficulty).[/p][/*][/list][p]The frequency of receiving touch damage from monsters has been reduced by 2 times.[/p][p]These changes are aimed at making the early stage of the game more comfortable for new players and speeding up progress in the first locations. Now the first steps in Singoru will become easier, and mastering the basic mechanics more comfortable.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Hero Rebalance[/h3][p][b]Clara[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Added a new specialization that allows, upon a successful dodge, to increase the hero’s movement speed by 30% for 1 second.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Mysterious Code[/b][/h3][p]In honor of the release of the update, we are giving you a mysterious code: [b]HALLOFFAME[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ac8bd3548349f6206a91d611421d16d3c8964c7f.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]That is all for now, Brave Ones. We hope that you will appreciate the new features! Stay with us, share your impressions of the game — we are always happy to hear feedback and make the game even better![/p][p]Success to you on your path to glory — and may the Hall of Fame preserve the memory of your victories![/p]

[p]Brave ones![/p][p][/p][p]We’re back again to tell you about all the latest updates in The Braves! So, put on your armor, grab your best weapon — and off to new adventures! It’s time to reveal what’s in store for you.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Updated Base Screen[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The main base screen has been revamped and now looks a bit different. In the updated base, you’ll notice some new details, including mysterious ruins. These ruins will become the foundation of a future building — [b]the[/b] [b]Hall of Fame[/b]. At that very place the legends and achievements of the greatest heroes will be kept, and the building itself will be available for construction in one of the upcoming updates.
But that’s not all. While you’re exploring the updated base screen, brave heroes have already set out to scout the lands surrounding the city. But soon, however, you’ll uncover a true discovery — the Mine will appear right on the location map, and who knows what resources and secrets it might reveal?

notes.title: Developer Diary #31
notes.content:
[p][b]Brave Ones![/b][/p][p]We are glad to present a new issue of the [i]Developer Diary[/i]![/p][p]For everyone eager to know what changes and innovations await the world of Singoru in the near future, we are ready to lift the veil of mystery.
In this edition, we’ll talk about the [b]Hall of Fame[/b], the upcoming event, and a bit about the [b]Star Coins[/b].[/p][h2]Hall of Fame:[/h2][p]Do you want to prove to everyone that you are the real hero here, not just some random newbie?
Soon, the Hall of Fame will open in the game — a place where only the best of the best will remain.
There, your name will shine brighter than trophies, and even monsters will whisper about your achievements… though mostly while scattering in panic.[/p][p]Now let’s take a closer look at the rankings.
If you thought it all boiled down to a character’s level, don’t jump to conclusions.
The Hall of Fame will count much more than just numbers in a profile.
It takes into account everything that makes a player into a true legend.[/p][list][*][p][b]Profile Level[/b]
The classic measure: the higher your level, the higher your name on the lists. Simple math, but very pleasing for the ego.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Kills[/b]
If bosses start mentally writing their will at your appearance — welcome to this ranking.
The more difficult the mode and the further hidden the enemy, the more fame points you’ll earn.
And yes, bosses will hate you — and rightfully so.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Portal Unlocking[/b]
Are you summoning in batches, until the Aether visits you like an old friend?
Then this is where you’ll prove to everyone that you’re the top collector in Singoru.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Equipment[/b]
Every item you obtain adds to your rating, and its value depends on rarity: the higher the rarity and star rank, the more points you gain.
Step by step, it’s your equipment that determines your place among the best. And those who say that “gear isn’t everything” clearly haven’t been to the Hall of Fame.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Clans[/b]
Yes, they don’t exist yet. But a place for them in the Hall of Fame is already prepared. Is that a hint from Singoru? Maybe.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Initial Version of the Hall of Fame[/h3][p]Over time it will develop, gain new features, and become even more exciting.
Ahead are seasons and leagues, new stages, and of course, rewards.
After all, being at the top is already an achievement, but receiving a worthy reward for it is doubly satisfying.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Event Announcement – [i]“Back to School!”[/i][/h2][p]School — that place where summer always ended sooner than you wanted, the alarm clock rang louder than usual, homework felt endless, tests always came “suddenly,” and breaks were far too short.
And yet, it was exactly from these moments that the most memorable years were made: a little chaos, a little discipline, and so many stories that still come to mind even now.[/p][p]Now you have the chance to return to the atmosphere of school days again, but in a much more enjoyable format.
Instead of notebooks and diaries, rewards await you:[/p][list][*][p]star coins,[/p][/*][*][p]three new types of weapons,[/p][/*][*][p]a fresh set of armor,[/p][/*][*][p]and more![/p][/*][/list][p]And for those who always like to stand out even during the “school assembly,” new hero skins have been prepared — let’s talk about a couple of them now.[/p][h3][b]Bjorn – The Teacher We Didn’t Deserve![/b][/h3][p]Away with boring lectures and pointless standing around.
This teacher can do far more than read notes from a sheet: he will teach self-defense, mastery of cold weapons, and, of course, how to look stylish in any situation.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/cd3c0fa23b7ab0a8afcee763f8a8af64b454d189.png"][/img][/p][p]But there is one small rule: better not joke about his mohawk.
Otherwise, he may vividly demonstrate exactly what he teaches in his classes.
Of course, you have nothing to fear — he’s a polite person.
But the poor monsters who dare cross him in a bad mood had better order themselves some pretty memorial plaques in advance.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/85916f3547b168faeb43a5e3a03645ac2eaefee1.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Aerin – The Bad Girl Who Conquered Many Hearts![/b][/h3][p]Forget model students and good little girls — the school legend is entirely different.
She is beautiful, daring, and possesses a rare talent: to conquer hearts just as easily as she breaks them.
No wonder the school corridors still whisper stories of those who dared to fall for her gaze, only to spend a long time nursing their broken hearts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/bf35b8a8c84a3468fbf3e0c2c1833e264d8ffd4e.png"][/img][/p][p]But don’t mistake her smile for a promise: it’s more of a challenge.
And if you decide to test your luck, be prepared to end up either as her admirer, or on the list of those she easily and mercilessly wrapped around her finger.
Still, the heart of the school troublemaker is like a precious trophy: it rarely goes to anyone, but what a prize it is for the winner![/p][p]The rest of the details we’ll keep for now — they will become the subject of the event’s very first lesson.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]About the Star Coins[/h2][p]First of all, we’d like to note that Star Coins are not some rare “for show” reward, but a full-fledged currency that can be earned in different modes and used for many purchases on the market.
Already, Star Coins are available not only in marathons, but also in boss battles, as well as in daily rewards and events.[/p][p]In addition, there will be special promotions and events with increased drop rates.
We continue to develop the system: in the future, new modes and activities will appear that will serve as additional sources of coins.[/p][p]We want you to always have several ways of obtaining currency — and for each of them to bring both enjoyment from the game and the freedom to choose how to spend what you’ve earned.
Don’t miss the chance to earn more![/p][hr][/hr][p]That’s all!
Stay tuned for more news, because there’s still a lot of exciting things ahead!
In the meantime — share your impressions and expectations in the comments.[/p][p][b]Forward, Brave Ones![/b][/p]

notes.title: The "Era of Stars" update
notes.content:
[p]Brave ones![/p][p]We are pleased to present to you the new major update for The Braves! We have a lot of news, big and small, so let’s not waste any time and dive straight into what awaits you![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Star Coins Drop[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b]Brave ones, the moment has come to test your valor![/p][p]Starting today, Star Coins have become the official reward for defeating bosses in Hardcore mode! But that’s just the beginning — soon this rare currency will become part of another unique mode. Stay tuned for updates!  Show what you're capable of — challenge the strongest opponents, face the harshest trials, and earn this truly rare currency, which will find wide use across the Singoru realms![/p][p]Let the stars witness your feats![/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Armor: Star Fortress Set[/b][/h2][p]Since the Ether began calling heroes, the world has changed. Not suddenly — more like someone started a long-forgotten mechanism. The gears of fate, resting for centuries, have begun to turn again.  Strange creatures appeared, unstable portals opened, mysterious artifacts and enigmatic coins were discovered. They were called Star Coins — for their shimmering light and the feeling that each one contains a fragment of something distant and powerful.  The material of these coins turned out to be unusual. It was melted down, studied, and combined with other metals. Thus, the Star Fortress Set was born — a full set of armor created for those who face death without flinching.  What advantages does the Star Fortress Set offer, you ask? Let’s break it down:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Star Fortress Armor [/b] [/h3][list][*][p]+6% health at uncommon rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+16% health at rare rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]Reduces incoming damage by +10% at epic rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+32% chance for experience drop from enemies at legendary rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+0.28% armor for each percentage of missing health at mythical rarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Star Fortress Helmet[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b] [/b] +6% health at uncommon rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+16% health at rare rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]-9.9% cooldown time for abilities at epic rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+7 seconds to invulnerability duration after resurrection at legendary rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+20% experience gained at mythical rarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Star Fortress Boots [/b] [/h3][list][*][p]+6% health at uncommon rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+16% health at rare rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+11% projectile speed at epic rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+7.7% movement speed at legendary rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+3% health per passive skill at mythical rarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Star Fortress Gloves [/b] [/h3][list][*][p]+6% attack at uncommon rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+15% attack at rare rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+5.5% skill range at epic rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+4% damage per evolution of active skill at legendary rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]30% chance of double damage for all evolutions at mythical rarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Star Fortress Ring [/b] [/h3][list][*][p]+6% attack at uncommon rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]+15% attack at rare rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]Additional skill restrictions in the match: 4 at epic rarity  [/p][/*][*][p]10% chance to restore 10% health upon taking damage at legendary rarity [/p][/*][*][p] +1 passive skill slot at mythical rarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Full Set Bonus [/b] [/h3][list][*][p]+2 Resurrections[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/5c03222ae7bdbd931d1115b68c7c0bedd030c9ce.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]Attention! This set is only available in the "Equipment" tab in the Market building and can be purchased with Star Coins.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]More Control in Battle[/b][/h2][p]Braves, meet one of the most useful combat interface improvements!  No more guessing and missed rotations — each active unique ability is now accompanied by a clear timer showing exactly how many seconds are left before the next use.[/p][p]Even if you're just starting your journey in The Braves, the updated interface will help you get up to speed with battle mechanics faster. And if you're a veteran — your tactical play will become even more precise and confident.  Forward, Braves! Your abilities are now fully under control![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Rebalancing Frost Shards[/b][/h2][p]We closely monitor how abilities perform in battle and listen to your feedback. Thanks to this, one of the old abilities has been reworked, retaining its core concept but gaining new, more efficient mechanics. We are talking about the Frost Shards and their evolution — Explosive Shards.[/p][p]Previously, the shards always fired straight behind the character in a straight line. Now, they home in on the nearest enemies behind you, prioritizing those closest to the character. If there are several targets behind you, the Frost Shards will be evenly distributed among them when the ability is activated.[/p][p]These changes also apply to Explosive Shards.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Notifications[/b][/h2][p]You asked — we added it!  Now, all important updates are marked with notifications — those little red dots that appear on buttons, tabs, and icons when:[/p][list][*][p]You receive a new piece of equipment or hero[/p][/*][*][p]You have enough shards to upgrade a hero's rarity[/p][/*][*][p]New slots open in the market or bank[/p][/*][*][p]New features or important events appear  [/p][/*][/list][p]With them, it’s easier: you don’t need to search for anything — the game will guide you on where to look.  Navigation has become faster, and gameplay even more convenient![/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Academy Branch: Summoning[/b][/h2][p]The Academy continues to develop, and now there is a new branch of study — specifically for summoner heroes!  The Summoning branch opens up unique abilities that strengthen summoned minions in battle.[/p][p]Several heroes have reconsidered their paths and switched their specialization. Now their primary focus will be Summoning, rather than Attack, Defense, or Support, as it was before.[/p][p]We present to you a list of these heroes:[/p][list][*][p]Terra[/p][/*][*][p]Sylpha[/p][/*][*][p]Calizk[/p][/*][*][p]Jabir [/p][/*][/list][p]These heroes will gain access to the unique abilities of the Summoning branch and become stronger as summoners on the battlefield through their minions.[/p][p]What about the resources already invested in training these heroes, you ask? The answer is simple: we will reset the upgraded skills in the Academy and return all runes and gold spent in full. This way, you can redistribute them as you see fit![/p][p]To train heroes in the Summoning branch, you will need new Summoning Runes and gold coins.  Summoning Runes can be obtained just like other runes:[/p][list][*][p]In the market, as a regular resource[/p][/*][*][p]At points of interest during matches[/p][/*][*][p]By defeating bosses[/p][/*][*][p]By opening event chests[/p][/*][*][p]Or you can buy sets in the bank — quick and convenient![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Hero Rebalance[/b][/h2][p][b]Jabir: [/b] With the arrival of Roxy in the world of Singoru, Jabir's times have become difficult. He quickly realized that he was outmatched by the innate talent of the young demoness in controlling living flame. But he was not ready to give up.  In search of new weapons, he turned to ancient legends of a powerful artifact that grants control over fire. That’s when he found the magical lamp — the [i]Wishbringer[/i]. And now, he has a chance to prove that skill earned through hard work surpasses any innate abilities.[/p][p][b]New Unique Abilities at Legendary Rarity: [/b] [/p][list][*][p]-40% cooldown time for Ifrit and his evolution  [/p][/*][*][p] 25% chance to deal double damage with Ifrit and his evolution   [/p][/*][*][p]+35% damage for Ifrit and his evolution   [/p][/*][*][p]-7% damage for other weapons   [/p][/*][*][p]Throws a bottle of unstable mixture toward the cursor, which leaves a fire puddle upon destruction. Cooldown: 5 seconds.   [/p][/*][*][p]+25% skill area of effect   [/p][/*][*][p]Chance to inflict Burning on enemies when dealing fire damage  1% chance to heal 1% of maximum health when dealing fire damage   [/p][/*][*][p]+1 level to Ifrit's evolution: Ifrit Destroyer[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Mythical Rarity: [/b]  [/p][list][*][p]+2 levels for Ifrit at the start of the match   [/p][/*][*][p]+1 Ifrit summoned   [/p][/*][*][p]Throws a bottle of highly unstable mixture toward the cursor, which leaves a blue fire puddle upon destruction. Cooldown: 5.5 seconds.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h2][b]New Hero Skins[/b][/h2][p]Our heroes have received new skins, some of which are making their debut:[/p][list][*][p][b]Shorty Tordi[/b]: +2.5% attack[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cyber-Viking Singvard[/b]: +0.7% attack for every 10 levels in the match[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rebel Roxy[/b]: -5% ability cooldown time[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unnamed Black Cat[/b]: 5.5% chance of ability reactivation (available only through purchase of the permanent bank offer "Clump of Darkness")[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dark Elf Barrett[/b]: -2.5% ability cooldown time[/p][/*][*][p][b]Plunderer Martina[/b]: -2.5% ability cooldown time (available only through purchase of the permanent bank offer "Hero's Path 5")[/p][/*][*][p][b]Poisonous Flower Elya[/b]: +5.5% attack[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sea Deity Bridget[/b]: +5% experience gain in the match[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cyber-General Guan Yu[/b]: +8.5% Armor (available only through purchase of the permanent bank offer "Path of 1024 Swords")[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dark Knight Thomas[/b]: 10% chance to restore 2% health when receiving damage[/p][/*][*][p][b]Herald of Death Annette[/b]: 5.5% chance to deal double damage (available only through purchase of the permanent bank offer "Call of Demise")[/p][/*][*][p][b]Well Spirit Annette[/b]: 0.09% chance to restore 0.5% health when dealing damage[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fridge Jack[/b]: +1.5% attack for every 10 levels in the match[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kashta-Panther[/b]: +2.5% projectile speed[/p][/*][*][p][b]Glacia. Project I.C.E.[/b]: +5.5% projectile speed [/p][/*][/list][p]You can already find the new skins in the Tavern and acquire them with Transformation Masks, Gemstones, Star Coins, or in new Bank offers![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Hot New Arrivals at the Goblin Bank![/b][/h2][p]Step into the [b]“Best”[/b] section — rare goods are waiting for you at irresistibly good prices. Don’t miss your chance to stock up and snatch up the best deals and offer chains that are sure to win you over![/p][p] [/p][h2][b] New Portal Openings[/b][/h2][p]Braves, do you hear the crackling of breaking ice and the roar of burning flames? The elements are clashing, and at their intersection, guided by the Ether, new heroes arrive in the world! Meet the Portal of the Elemental Crossroads and the Portal of Elemental Confrontation![/p][p][b]In the Portal of the Elemental Crossroads, three new unique heroes await you. What can they do? What will they surprise you with? notes.title: Developer Diary #30
notes.content:
[p][b]Brave Ones![/b][/p][p]We’re excited to present a new edition of the “Developer Diary”![/p][p]For all those who crave insight into what changes and innovations await the world of Singoru in the near future, we’re ready to lift the veil of mystery.
In this edition, we’ll talk about changes to the event, new features, and our plans for the future![/p][h3]Reward Rework in “The Great Heist” Event[/h3][p]([i]Or how one stubborn Goblin tricked the Bank again![/i])[/p][p]Remember that daring theft after which the Goblin Bank swore everything was now under control?[/p][p]Well… surprise![/p][p]Our old acquaintance, the Goblin-Thief, has outwitted everyone again. Despite tightened security, locked gates, barbed wire, and even a couple of magical toads, he somehow snuck inside and snatched the Bill of Exchange once more! Yes, those same shiny and valuable ones.
The Bank, burning with rage and shame, once again turns to you, Brave Ones! Help catch the pointy-eared rascal and earn generous rewards.
In these troubled times, the Bank has re-evaluated its principles and realized: the time for change has come. In the name of justice and to inspire new feats, it has reimagined the very essence of rewards! From a promotional scroll we quote:[/p][quote][p]“Thus declares the Bank to all the loyal and valiant: the fragments once given as marks of courage have earned their rest. From now on, heroes who return the Bill of Exchange will, among other rewards, receive [b]Star Coins[/b] and gain access to [b]new weapons[/b] — rare, glorious, and fit only for the chosen.”[/p][/quote][h3]New Weapons[/h3][p]Three new additions are already in stock:[/p][p][b]Resolver[/b]
[i]“What solves problems better than a 12-gauge round?”[/i]
This shotgun doesn’t ask questions — it solves them. Powerful, reliable, and so blunt that its blasts shatter not just walls but arguments. Grants the skill “Stone Shrapnel” — a loud reminder of who’s boss.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/5c32f40492fa670e6683294adab53d0188a6e84b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Singorian Piano[/b]
[i]“Old school, new holes”[/i]
A mechanical monster built as if in the basement of a mad gunsmith. Steel casing, handy wooden grips, and a precision arrow-launching mechanism. Grants the skill “Thunder Arrows” — a fast, accurate, and noisy way to leave your opinion in every doorway.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/075bc91f31a86863ab50a4fb298bdb9d797308de.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Fiery Jack[/b]
[i]“The recipe is simple: glass, flame, panic”[/i]
At first glance, it’s just a bottle — but look inside, and you’ll see chaos. This “cocktail” contains concentrated anarchy, ready to burst free upon the first throw. Grants the skill “Blazing Flame” — an easy way to set any party on fire.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/589ca5dc02fac7f287cc43c26097ba30b80467a2.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Additionally:[/b]
Each of the new weapons increases skill [b]evolution level by +1 at Legendary tier.[/b]
At [b]Mythical tier[/b], the weapon gains a c[b]hance to deal critical skill damage[/b], significantly boosting combat performance.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]New Feature: Notifications[/h3][p]([i]Now nothing important will slip by[/i])[/p][p]When immersed in gameplay, it’s easy to miss a new item, quest, or interesting offer — especially during events or summons.
To ensure nothing crucial escapes your notice, we’re adding a notification system to the game.
You’ll now receive clear alerts about new events, rewards, and opportunities directly in the interface.
This feature will launch very soon and make your gaming journey even more convenient and intuitive.
Stay tuned and don’t miss any chance for valuable rewards![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Future Plans: Social Features[/h3][p]([i]Time to unite in-game![/i])[/p][p]We know you’ve been waiting for this. And we’ve got great news: we’ve started working on an in-game social system!
We’re planning chat, friend lists, clans, and rankings — everything you need to not only battle, collect rewards, and complete events, but also communicate, unite, and share experiences without needing external platforms.
We won’t promise these features will appear in the very next update, but we can say this: development has begun, and we’ll do everything we can to avoid long delays.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8591e76514c2f1bd851ef51cdec1e3797704a8cb.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for staying with us — many exciting things lie ahead!
In the meantime, share your thoughts and expectations in the comments. Onward, Brave Ones![/p]

notes.title: Developer Diary #29
notes.content: [p]Brave Ones![/p][p]We are happy to present a new issue of the “Developer Diary”![/p][p]For all those eager to learn what changes and innovations await the world of Singoru, we are ready to lift the veil.[/p][p]In this issue, we’ll reveal two more heroes coming to the Pure Soul Portal, as well as a brand-new armor set.[/p][h2]Update: Pure Soul Portal[/h2][p]When the Pure Soul Portal first opened, only the chosen could pass through — those with unshakable will and a soul as pure as Aether’s glow. Since then, their ranks remained unchanged. Until now.[/p][p]We’ve already introduced [b]Singward[/b] — one of the new summoned. Today, it’s time to name the others.[/p][p][b]Glacia[/b] and [b]Tenkyo[/b] — two new names, two new faces in the story to come. Along with Singward, they join the familiar heroes of the Pure Soul Portal.[/p][p]Important: [b]The new heroes do not replace the old ones.[/b] They are added to the summoning pool, broadening choices and opening new paths for those brave enough to step through the Portal.[/p][p][i]The old souls remain. But now, new ones have joined them.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Glacia – The Enchanting Ice Mistress[/h2][p]Glacia was an ordinary girl who loved winter. Unfortunately, city winters rarely looked like the ones in books or films. Most days, her window revealed nothing but a grey-brown slush. Still, on those rare occasions when snowflakes gently drifted to the ground and crunched softly underfoot, Glacia would go for a walk. She’d buy ice cream and head to the local skating rink. Even when the frost nipped at her cheeks, she welcomed the cold — wearing a look of utter happiness.[/p][p]At night, wrapped in her favorite blanket, she would dream. What superpower would she choose? Time-stop? Elemental control? Super speed to finally stop missing the bus? Each day brought a new story in her head — where she was the hero saving lives. But morning always brought reality: alarms, hurry, routine.[/p][p]Until one day... a very normal winter’s day decided to grant her wish — in a most unusual way.[/p][p]An icicle. Ordinary. Determined. Fell from a rooftop — right onto her head. If this had been a cartoon, stars would’ve spun around her. In reality? Darkness.[/p][p]But Glacia didn’t wake up in the hospital. Instead, she found herself in silence. It was odd, but not frightening — as if she was wrapped in something invisible, warm and soft, despite the lingering cold.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/569385875a3952b76a288f36e266763bed4d4726.png"][/img][/p][p]When she opened her eyes, she was in an unfamiliar world. The locals called it Singoru — a place where good teeters on the edge, and evil… well, evil here is serious: magic, swords, and fangs that no one bothers to clean out of principle.[/p][p]Here, Glacia felt a power awaken within her — a living, obedient cold. She could summon icy shards and send them flying at her enemies. When danger arose, frost burst forth, freezing threats in place and allowing her to act. Ice was her gift. And at last — she became a hero. A real one.[/p][p]Her journey was… unorthodox. But Glacia had no complaints. Not every day does an icicle kickstart your superhero career.[/p][p][/p][h3]A Comic Book Heroine[/h3][p]Once, while gazing at her reflection in a frozen lake, Glacia thought, “I could use a new outfit.” Not armor, not a robe — an outfit. Stylish, like in comics. With a visor. White, obviously.[/p][p]What local tailors offered was… boring. She tried making something herself — but it always turned out eerily familiar. As if the fabric itself insisted: “Leave it be.” She almost gave up.[/p][p]Almost — until she met Singward. Or rather, his upgraded form: more metal, less knight. She didn’t recognize him at first — but the inspiration was immediate. A few days of questioning (and missed lunches for Singward), and the name of the master was revealed: Nicolas.[/p][p]His workshop looked like a mad scientist's lab — which only reassured her she was in the right place. Two weeks of persistence, and Nicolas gave in. He created the suit — sleek, white, with the desired visor, and even with hair-color-changing tech! He added boosters too, just to stop her asking.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/dcdcdfebe1d009ae38fc78fb3382814ab16fc39e.png"][/img][/p][p]Now, Glacia has her new costume. And she feels more heroic than ever. Because now — she’s got the costume to match.[/p][p][/p][h2]Tenkyo – The Witch with a Guitar[/h2][p]She was a superstar. Not a 15-second TikTok flicker — a real one. Guitar. Stage. A screaming crowd. Her solos were memorized by heart, guitarists envied her, and fans would trade years for a ticket to her concert. She hadn’t reached legendary status yet, but she was on her way — fueled by late-night rehearsals, worn-out picks, and blistered fingers.[/p][p]On the outside — glamour and applause. Inside — silence, melancholy, and aching loneliness. Her parents were long gone, few friends remained, and the fame, the money, the fans... all felt like glittery dust. All she had left of her past was her old guitar and a noisy amp that hummed like it shared her pain.[/p][p]One day, after a concert, she stayed behind on the empty stage. The lights went out, the audience left — she sat alone, strumming, trying to coax the last remaining notes from deep inside. The melody she played was soft — like a farewell to those she’d lost and to the loneliness that never left.[/p][p]And then — like a scene from a bad movie: a short circuit, a spark, a bang... and a lighting rig crashed down on her.[/p][p]A grim ending? It would’ve been. But her life decided to play out a scene from a manga she once read under the covers as a child.[/p][p]She awoke in complete darkness. She couldn’t see, but she felt… something watching her. Hundreds of little eyes. Fear? No. On the contrary — peace. A strange feeling of home. She reached out instinctively — and her guitar was there. As if it had followed her.[/p][p]She emerged into a strange forest, teeming with odd creatures. Some ran, others flew at her. Tenkyo did what she did best — she played.[/p][p]Notes poured out, vibrating the air. Her music echoed through the woods — and through a swarm of bats. One surged ahead, striking enemies threatening her. She kept playing, unaware of a wolf sneaking up. Only when it leapt did a whirlwind spark around her, laced with lightning. The wolf fell — lifeless.[/p][p]She ended her solo, staring at what remained: fallen monsters and a few bats that had died protecting her.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/b43674ae6d18fc2702b2d60a07ac609e5c050e91.png"][/img][/p][p]From then on, stories spread through Singoru — of the witch with the guitar. She played the music of storms, commanded bats… and always traveled alone. But now — she’s no longer lonely.[/p][p][/p][h3]What Matters Most to a Musician[/h3][p]It’d be a lie to say Tenkyo never thought of changing her style. Of course she had. Sometimes. When seeing new fabrics at the market. Or catching her reflection in a shop window. Or standing beneath the twilight sky with her guitar, wondering: “Should I change something?”[/p][p]But the thought always slipped away — like wind through guitar strings.[/p][p]She was fine as is. Guitar — there. Sound — pure. Rhythm — hers. Companions near, road beneath her feet, endless tunes in her mind — everything she needed was already with her.[/p][p]One day, maybe, she’ll change. Surprise, redesign, redefine. But not now. Now, something else matters more.[/p][p]Because what’s the most important thing for any musician?[/p][p]Music.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Equipment – Star Fortress Set[/h2][p]Since Aether began calling to heroes, the world has changed. Not suddenly — more like an ancient mechanism being reawakened. The gears of fate, long silent, have started to turn once again.[/p][p]Strange creatures appeared, unstable portals, mysterious artifacts… and coins. They called them Star Coins — for their shimmering glow and the sense that each held a fragment of something vast and powerful.[/p][p]The material was unique. It was melted down, studied, combined with other metals. Thus was born the Star Fortress Set — a complete armor forged for those who stare death in the eye and do not blink.[/p][p]In every piece — from helm to ring — lives something more than mere steel. Its power lies not just in protection, but in what it grants: the ability to return to life. Twice.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/5c03222ae7bdbd931d1115b68c7c0bedd030c9ce.png"][/img][/p][p]Its origin remains uncertain. Some believe it's tied to the stars, others — to Aether itself. The stubborn ones? They stay silent, wear it again, and that’s enough.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Sometimes, all it takes is one more chance to win.[/i][/p][p][i]This set gives you two.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]That’s it for now! Stay tuned — much more is coming. In the meantime, share your thoughts and expectations in the comments.[/p][p]Forward, Brave Ones![/p]

notes.title: Developer's Diary #28
notes.content:
[p]Brave Ones![/p][p]We are happy to present a new issue of the Developer's Diary![/p][p]For those who crave to know what changes and innovations await the world of Singoru in the near future, we are ready to lift the veil of mystery.
In this new issue, we will tell you about one of the new heroes appearing in the Pure Soul Portal, as well as the rework of Jabir and a new summoned creature.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Hero – Singward[/b][/h2][p]Singward was a paladin from the Priory Temple in the mountains of Snowdonia — a place where cold and rain were more reliable than prayers. His goddess had no name, and that seemed to suit everyone just fine. No name — fewer arguments.[/p][p]He wasn’t a fanatic. He did what he was told: punished, burned, scourged. Not out of cruelty, but out of practicality — in the 13th century, there wasn’t much of a choice. His faith was as straight as the road to the gallows: the goddess gave an order, he obeyed. Doubts were for those who lived to old age.[/p][p]One day, he was ordered to eliminate a peasant who proclaimed himself “the goddess’s son.” Singward silently donned his black armor, took up his axe, and walked out the door.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/5f5b3919da775e13bff361307d5bab8aae617df0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]And tripped. On a wet stone by the threshold.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The axe slipped. The blade tilted upward. He fell — straight onto it. No battle, no glory. Only rusted metal and a stupid end.[/p][p]But death is not always the finale. Sometimes it’s just a scene change.[/p][p]Singward awoke in another world. Neither light nor dark accepted him. He was devoured by the Aether — silent, ancient, as if the very air remembered him. It gave him a body — familiar, but changed. Power was no longer granted from above. It lived within him.[/p][p]Now his strikes didn’t just cut — they shattered. The blood of enemies flowed endlessly, as if it no longer believed in healing. Wounds wouldn’t close, fear preceded pain. Singward became faster, sharper, and his signature move — a circular axe slash — became a dance of death. Swift, bloody, efficient.[/p][p]But the most terrifying thing was his blood.[/p][p]If he was wounded, it came alive. It ran along the ground, waiting. If an enemy stepped into it — the torment began. Old scars reopened, new ones appeared by themselves. And Singward — healed. As if every strike filled him, and every drop returned with interest.[/p][p]— “Thank you, my lady… for this rebirth,” — he whispered.[/p][p]What did he mean? New flesh? New strength? Or the old right to be cruel?[/p][p]No one asked. And it was better that way.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Cyber Paladin Who Kept His Faith![/b][/h3][p]In Singoru, where enemies outnumber fields of grain, Singward fought tirelessly. His axe shattered flesh as stubbornly as he himself — without rage, without mercy. Faith remained in him, but it no longer needed words. Only action.[/p][p]But even strength born not of gods but of man has its limit. That day, the monsters didn’t come as an army — but as a storm. There were too many. Even he couldn’t withstand them.[/p][p]He fell, drenched in blood, as consciousness faded. Somewhere in the darkness, he glimpsed a man with silver hair and glass over one eye. A voice echoed like a tomb. Light. Pain. Then — nothing.[/p][p][/p][p][i]He awoke in a new body.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Before him stood that man — his name was Nicolas. A scientist. He had found Singward nearly dead and rebuilt him — bone by bone, thought by thought. The ordinary body was gone. In its place — armor. Cold, intricate, alien. Without it, Singward died. Inside it — he lived.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/3c43647d5346399ee46865bda411be164d0cc021.png"][/img][/p][p]At first, the body wouldn’t obey. Metal wasn’t skin. Movements were jerky. The axe — as if held by new hands. But in time, he learned not just to use the armor — but to be it.[/p][p]Singward didn’t become someone else. He simply stopped being limited. His soul remained unchanged — faithful, straight as a blade. And his faith, having passed through two deaths, grew stronger.[/p][p]He was ready for battle once more. The shell had changed — but not the essence. He was still the same paladin. Only now — alive against all odds.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Hero Rework – Jabir[/b][/h2][p]Jabir was once hailed as the greatest master of living flame — until Roxy appeared. A young demoness, gifted with fiery power without a single day of training. Her natural talent surpassed all of Jabir’s achievements, earned through years of dedication — and it was an unbearable humiliation.[/p][p]In search of a new weapon, he turned to ancient legends of a powerful artifact granting dominion over fire. His journey led him through dense forests, icy mountains, and even a gloomy graveyard, where he met the Headless Thomas.[/p][p]Finally, in the desert lands that had swallowed many a brave soul, Jabir discovered an ancient temple. After many battles with its guardians, he found an unusual lamp. When he wiped away the dust, a blazing spirit appeared, scorching his eyebrows.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/4f62033e076f7c6baa32e98b74a317e39f9d3bb0.png"][/img][/p][p]The spirit called itself Ifrit, and offered not three wishes — but something greater: the ability to summon its power in battle. But to fully unlock Ifrit’s might, Jabir had to find a special way to manifest himself in combat. Now he had a chance to prove that mastery earned through hardship could surpass any natural gift.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Minion – Ifrit[/b][/h2][p]In ancient scrolls, secret manuscripts, and tales passed by word of mouth, he is known by many names. Spirit of Fire, Lord of Flame, the True Djinn — all these titles are his, but only one name does he accept as true — Ifrit.[/p][p]In lands scorched by relentless sun, where sands guard millennia-old secrets, legends of him are told. Some say he is the keeper of deepest desires, capable of granting the impossible. Others, trembling with fear, whisper that he is the harbinger of the world’s end, a spirit who will one day raise flames so great they will consume the world — to create a new, perfect one.[/p][p][b]Ifrit[/b] is a child of primordial fire, a being whose very essence is flame. In battle, he is like the sun incarnate descending to earth. His attacks are not mere strikes, but torrents of pure flame, incinerating anyone who dares to stand in his path. Yet this is but a fraction of his power.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ea3ad0f4ef43152a2536aa47a789a65be39d0aff.png"][/img][/p][p]When [b]Ifrit[/b] returns to his true form, when his strength peaks, he becomes the element of fire itself. His very presence is a storm of flame, able to reduce entire armies to ash. Any who draw near will face the full wrath of his fury — for to oppose him is to challenge the heart of fire itself.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/d8387f45bba7bceb30eedaaeeb48304f4649d203.png"][/img][/p][p]In his eyes, eternity flickers. In his breath, the whisper of ancient times. He is the embodiment of power, wisdom, and wrath — a spirit whose name strikes fear even into the bravest. Ifrit, Lord of Flame, keeper of secrets and destroyer of worlds — the ancient Djinn whose name echoes across existence.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Star Coins[/b][/h2][p]Important news for all Brave Ones![/p][p]We are almost finished with a complete rebalancing of the in-game market. A major change is coming your way very soon![/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Star Coins — a reward for the bravest![/b][/u][/p][p][/p][p]For now, they can be earned by defeating bosses in Hardcore Mode — prove your valor and claim what you deserve! But this is only the beginning: in the future, Star Coins will become part of another unique mode... details coming soon![/p][p]Very soon it will be time to show your strength! Prove you are worthy of these rare rewards. Let the stars bear witness to your feats![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ca6ed5eecf6cb219a48414d868e1190854b9e35e.png"][/img][/p][p]That's all for now! Stay tuned — there's much more exciting news ahead! In the meantime, share your thoughts and expectations in the comments. Onward, Brave Ones![/p]

notes.title: Developer Diary #27
notes.content: [p][b]Brave Ones![/b][/p][p][/p][p]We are pleased to present a new issue of the [b]Developer Diary[/b]![/p][p]For all those who crave knowledge about the changes and innovations awaiting the world of [b]Singoru[/b] in the near future, we are ready to lift the veil of secrecy. In this new issue, we will show you a new portal, introduce the new heroes who will appear in it, and their appearances![/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Portal[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]They died…[/b][/p][p][b]Elai’s[/b] last breath dissolved in the poisonous mist. [b]Tordi[/b] fell into an eternal slumber in the snowy mountains. And [b]Roxy[/b]… well, more on her later. But instead of oblivion—a radiant rift where the Ether whispered: [i]"Step through."[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/34cda4cfd1aa4dc7bf56bdfbfe7218fd9850168d.png"][/img][/p][p]Passing through the gates became a new birth. Poison became an extension of Elai. Frost bowed to Tordi. Fire reignited within Roxy.[/p][p]The Ether calls new chosen ones. Whose spirit is strong enough to accept the gift of rebirth? Whose story will begin beyond these gates?[/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Elai – The Poison Keeper[/b][/h2][p]In her past life, Elai was a humble healer from medieval China, a lover of herbs, ointments, and reckless experiments—especially on herself.[/p][p]Elai wasn’t just a poison expert—she was literally made of them. Years of self-testing turned her body into something between an apothecary and a toxic swamp puddle. When she invented a universal antidote and proudly drank it, everything went exactly as planned. The antidote did defeat the poison. Except the poison [i]was[/i] her body. So the antidote, following its instructions perfectly, completely neutralized Elai. No side effects.[/p][p]Fortunately, death turned out to be temporary. Elai awoke in a new world, more energetic than ever, with a crossbow in hand and an even greater passion for poisons. Now she’s a heroine who literally radiates toxicity. Any monster daring to get close starts bubbling within seconds. And those who keep their distance? She can reach them with her trusty crossbow—loaded with thunderbolts. Poisoned ones.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/df728050a7c1bab85e0507e75223ff19d508a1d4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]How does poison even work through lightning?[/i] No one knows. Elai says: [i]"Alchemical secret."[/i] Then she winks. Very suspiciously.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Herbal Experiment[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]While battling in the grim walls of laboratories, Elai discovered intriguing records on alchemical experiments with mutagens derived from plant-based poisons. This experiment fascinated her—new knowledge, after all.[/p][p]She spent long nights hunched over a new formula. Dozens of sleepless nights, thousands of failed attempts, hundreds of liters of tea laced with a drop of poison (for strength) finally bore fruit![/p][p]The experimental concoction [b]"Stem #3826"[/b] was ready—a thick, murky liquid smelling of fresh roots and milk oolong. As always, Elai tested it on herself first. Three minutes later, she was lying on the floor, bubbling, with a sprout growing from her ear.[/p][p]When she woke up, she was no longer herself. Her skin became smooth as petals, vines coiled around her. Plants grew around her on their own—sometimes too aggressively. Rumor has it she sometimes turns into a flower. But only when no one’s watching.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8a8c3c6a019ad3af5c17b5b421db94a68cd157c4.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Roxy – The Fiery Hellion[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][i]"What awaits me after death?"[/i] Roxy spat at such nonsense. Her life was a whirlwind—parties, brawls, insane parachute jumps—anything that made her blood boil. If someone gave her a dirty look? They’d get a fist to the face. Easy as pie.[/p][p]But fate? A real bitch. In another brawl, someone stuck something sharp in her—maybe a knife, maybe a shard from the bottle she’d just smashed over the offender’s head. And just like that, she was on the other side.[/p][p][i]"What awaits me after death?!"[/i] Roxy smirked. [i]"Screw you all! Now I’m an immortal queen!"[/i] she roared, admiring herself in the mirror.[/p][p][b]Singoru[/b] gave her everything she ever wanted: eternal adrenaline, a killer look, and superpowers. Summoning demons to explode in enemies’ faces? Easy! Throwing Molotovs that burn brighter than some mage’s spells? Child’s play![/p][p][i]"Embrace me, new world—the great and terrible hellion…"[/i] she mused. [i]"Or maybe… Super-Arch-Hellion-Flame Empress, Mother of Fire, Head-Smasher…"[/i] She burst out laughing. [i]"Got a bit carried away."[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/aa657b0c18d2a73d6af728c19822552d95059dbd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Well then, [b]Singoru[/b], get ready! The rebel hellion has arrived to turn your world upside down! Let all hell tremble![/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Returning to Roots[/b][/h3][p][i]"What if… just for fun… I become human again? Like the good old days—skin that doesn’t burn in the sun, nails that don’t cut metal?"[/i][/p][p]Honestly, the idea wasn’t genius, but Roxy was hooked. First, she tried concentrating—maybe her inner human would emerge. It didn’t. Then she tried old phrases: [i]"Sim-salabim," "Shazam!" "Moon Prism…"[/i]—no luck.[/p][p]But Roxy doesn’t give up. She kicked open the nearest tavern door, scanned the room, and spotted a suspicious guy in a shiny vest, with cartoonish mustache and the gaze of a seasoned magician.[/p][p][i]"You, fancy-shirt wonder—a mage?"[/i] Roxy loomed over him.[/p][p][i]"Of course, child of flame! I am the Magnificent Illusionist!"[/i] he declared, flourishing a handkerchief that released a dove.[/p][p][i]"I need to turn human again. Without all this."[/i] She pointed at her horns, tail, and other bonuses.[/p][p]The mage (or illusionist—hard to tell) flashed a dazzling smile, waved his hands three times, and shouted:[/p][p][i]"Akhalay-Makhalay-Baraboom!"[/i][/p][p]He coughed, spat, and vanished in a puff of confetti.[/p][p]Roxy was already summoning a three-tiered selection of curses when she noticed—her skin was lighter, her nails normal, her tail gone! She rushed to a broken shop window, looked at herself—good old Roxy again! Well, almost. Her hair was better. And her skin glowed.[/p][p][i]"Akhalay-Makhalay, seriously?!"[/i] she yelled into nowhere. And of course, she smiled.[/p][p]Widely. Like a human. And like a demon. Simultaneously.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8fd53c4129ea4a262bee23b75b27c06483ae32c7.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Tordi – The Boy Who Froze on the Path to His Dream[/b][/h2][p]Once, there was a boy named Tordi who adored the stars. One day, he decided to steal a star from the sky. His parents laughed:[/p][p][i]"That’s like trying to catch the moon with a butterfly net!"[/i][/p][p]But Tordi was stubborn. At night, he climbed the mountains. The cold pierced his bones, but he didn’t give up. By morning, he collapsed from exhaustion… and woke up with the magical power of ice![/p][p]Suddenly, a monster leaped from behind a rock. In panic, Tordi shot icicles—and a skating rink formed beneath the monster. It slipped so spectacularly even Tordi giggled.[/p][p]In the valley, Tordi met a creature like an ice statue. It moved… and talked?[/p][p][i]"First time here?"[/i] asked Jack.[/p][p][i]"Yeah,"[/i] Tordi replied.[/p][p][i]"Welcome to Singoru! Here, we ice guardians protect the world from evil."[/i][/p][p]Since then, Tordi and Jack became a team. Rumor has it, if you climb the mountain, you can see them circling monsters, freezing them faster than grandma makes compote.[/p][p]And the star? Still in the sky—proud of its brave admirer.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/720067d25f731f242ce0597ebef299144ce2bab6.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]The Ring That Granted Power[/b][/h3][p]In the distant reaches of [b]Singoru[/b], where impassable peaks scraped the heavens and eternal ice gripped the land, the brave Tordi wandered. Deep within an ancient temple hidden among glacial halls, he discovered a wondrous artifact—a ring encased in ice, yet radiating strange, inexplicable warmth.[/p][p]The ancient relic granted its wearer the power to change forms. Of all possible shapes, Tordi chose the guise of a humble wanderer—he liked its unassuming nature. Now, he could walk among mortals without losing a shred of his icy might.[/p][p]Even as a young traveler, an unseen frosty haze surrounded him, hindering foes. None knew that beneath the guise of a simple drifter lurked the master of frost and cold.[/p][p][i]"If only my old man could see me now. He wouldn’t believe it,"[/i] Tordi sometimes chuckled, watching his enemies’ baffled faces.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/4039181566422dd5c376ebd417e45be0dd84c7e3.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]That’s All for Now![/b][/p][p]Stay tuned for more news—there’s plenty more to come! For now, share your thoughts and expectations in the comments. Onward, [b]Brave Ones[/b]![/p]
