notes.title: Wind of Change Update!
notes.content:
[b]Brave ones![/b]

We present to your attention a major new update for The Braves! We have lots of news, both big and small, so let's not waste time and quickly find out what awaits you!

[h2]New modes: Chase and Invasion[/h2]

We've prepared a series of new challenges for you - location modes. Each mode will specialize in a specific type of resource. So if you need hero manga to strengthen your heroes, then welcome to the "Chase" mode. And if you need construction materials for your base or runes for training at the Academy, it's better to choose the "Invasion" mode.
These modes are available in all locations, but certain conditions in normal and hardcore modes must be met to unlock them.
All game modes are available in each location, but certain conditions in normal and hardcore modes must be completed to unlock them.

[b]The progression system is built logically:[/b] for example, to unlock the "Invasion" mode in the "Forest" location on "Easy" difficulty, you first need to complete the "Easy" level in the "Graveyard" location in normal mode.

[b]Important note:[/b] resistance levels may vary even within the same location.
Don't worry about planning your path - the game will clearly show which stages and at what difficulty level need to be completed to unlock new opportunities.

Let's take a closer look at each of the new modes:

[h3]"Chase" mode[/h3]

Something incredible has happened in Singoru. The monsters that used to act chaotically have suddenly united around the strongest. They have chosen leaders for themselves - powerful creatures that they began to worship as deities. These leaders are not only smarter and stronger than their brethren, but also have a magical connection with ancient altars that grant them immortality.
We've tried to make each match in "Chase" mode unique. Each location has its own leader monster with special abilities and behavior tactics.

[b]How the new mode works:[/b]

From the very beginning of the match, an immortal leader monster will be chasing you. It cannot be killed in the usual way - it will pursue you until the altars connected to it are destroyed. But be careful: the monster won't just follow you. It will use its abilities to block paths, slow you down, or even call for reinforcements.

[b]Main objective[/b] - act quickly. Explore the location, find the altars and destroy them before the monster catches up with you. But remember: the enemy won't sit idly by! The longer you delay, the more dangerous the situation becomes. And if you don't manage to sever the monster leader's connection with the altars by the end of the match, you will lose this battle.

[h3]"Invasion" mode[/h3]

The standard rules no longer apply - now every match turns into a task to eliminate the threat. Ready for a real challenge? We present the new "Invasion" mode - dynamic, intense, requiring not only strength but also a well-thought-out strategy.

[b]How the new mode works:[/b]

At the beginning of the game, portals appear in the location and you have 5 minutes to destroy them and defeat the guardians - the Ethereal Hounds.
The higher the difficulty, the more stages: from one to three, each lasting 5 minutes.
Let's look at Easy difficulty: as soon as you appear in the location, a countdown timer starts. Portals appear on the map, and within the allotted 5 minutes of the stage you need to destroy the portals and defeat the invaders that appear from these very portals. If the portals or Ethereal Hounds are not destroyed when time runs out - it counts as a defeat.
If you manage to destroy the portals and Ethereal Hounds within the allotted time, then at the end of each stage you will face the location boss containing coveted resources and equipment.

[h2]Match duration changes[/h2]

Changes have occurred in the world of Singoru! Match durations have been shortened, making them more dynamic and exciting. This innovation not only speeds up gameplay but also makes it more thrilling. Now you'll have more opportunities to test your skills in a short time and enjoy every moment on the battlefield!
Let's see how much time it will take:
[list]
[*] Easy difficulty level of Normal mode, Chase and Invasion modes can be completed in just 5 minutes;
[*] Medium - in 10 minutes;
[*] Hard, Impossible and Infernal - in just 15 minutes;
[*] Hardcore mode match duration remains unchanged at 15 minutes.
[/list]
With the reduction in match duration, the number of bosses in locations has also changed:
[list]
[*] On Easy difficulty - 1 boss
[*] On Medium difficulty - 2 bosses
[*] On Hard, Impossible and Infernal - 3 bosses
[/list]
What about rewards, you ask? Although there are fewer bosses, the amount of rewards remains the same. So you'll be able to get the same resources and equipment items in less time!

[h2]Prism fragments turn into star coins[/h2]

We've carefully analyzed your feedback and would like to note the impressive efficiency of some players in collecting prism fragments. Unfortunately, the number of fragments obtained has significantly exceeded our expectations, creating a certain imbalance in the game economy.

We've also noticed that the current fragment usage system turned out to be quite limited and didn't provide sufficient variety of gameplay opportunities. We strive to offer you broader prospects and diverse options for using in-game currency.

Considering your comments that the ability to obtain resources for summoning heroes and weapons is wonderful, but gameplay shouldn't be limited to just this, we've decided to make significant changes. We're abandoning prism fragments and introducing a new currency - Star Coins.

In return, we're introducing a more flexible system where [b]Star Coins[/b] can be used to purchase a wide range of in-game items and opportunities. This will make gameplay more varied and exciting, giving you more choices and opportunities for development.

At this stage of implementing Star Coins, you can expect:
[list]
[*] Hero fragments in the "Hero Fragments" section of the Market
[*] Transformation Masks in the "Resources" section of the Market
[*] Various character appearances in the Tavern
[*] Ether and Infinity Prisms in the Bank and Market buildings at the following rates:
[*] Ether Prism - 150 Star Coins
[*] Infinity Prism - 300 Star Coins
[/list]
[u]All prism fragments you currently have will be automatically converted into the new currency - Star Coins at a 1:1 ratio.[/u]

In the future, we plan to expand the list of available items for Star Coins to make your gameplay even more exciting and varied.

Join the new era of Singoru and enjoy the updated economy system!

[h2]Gift Marathon: Monthly[/h2]

[b]Monthly[/b]

The Monthly Gift Marathon starts with the first monthly marathon that will last 28 days, after which it will switch to a cyclical mode.
The Monthly Gift Marathon will offer you 28 days of continuous reward collection. No tasks - just log into the game and claim your daily bonuses.
After completing the main stage, the gift marathon will switch to [b]cyclical mode[/b], where the rewards will change, but you'll be able to receive them using the familiar scheme. This will allow you to plan your time and always know when to expect new gifts.
No need to complete complex conditions or special requirements - just play and receive your bonuses. If you want more, we've prepared a premium part of the marathon with additional bonuses.

[h2]Sight customization[/h2]

Now you can flexibly customize your sight in the game.

[b]Auto-aim[/b] - the classic mode where the game automatically helps you acquire targets. Perfect for dynamic shootouts and beginners.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/a1431e8bb4059b648fdd4b65a748aa1c9c666390.gif[/img]

[b]Cursor aiming[/b] - advanced mode with full control over shots. Now you can precisely direct weapons through the cursor, which is especially important for experienced players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8ecba610a3435cf7c851684638ff456ac541aed0.gif[/img]

We've added a convenient switch so you can choose the most comfortable aiming method. On PC, you have two options:
[list]
[*] Directly in battle by pressing a special button (F).
[*] Through game settings.
[/list]
In the mobile version, which will be released soon, you'll only be able to change the aiming mode through the settings menu.

[b]The new feature currently only affects certain skills[/b]. We've compiled their list:
[list]
[*] Stone Shrapnel
[*] Earth Barrage
[*] Crushing Blow
[*]  Compass of Pain
[*] Thunder Arrows
[*] Arrow Thrower
[*] Steel Fan
[/list]
The choice is yours! Customize the aiming type to suit your playstyle. Remember: in cursor aiming mode, shot accuracy depends entirely on your skills and experience.

[h2]Changes to Daily Roulette Rewards[/h2]

No more "7500"! Now the size of the daily reward in coveted gold coins depends on your progress in locations:
[list]
[*] Starting from the Forest location (Easy), you can receive from 1,500 to 6,000 gold coins.
[*] From the Mycelium location (Easy), you can receive from 3,000 to 12,000 gold coins.
[*] From Bran Castle location (Easy), you can receive from 30,000 to 120,000 gold coins.
[*] From the Ridge location (Medium), you can receive from 450,000 to 1,800,000 gold coins!
[*] A pleasant addition to the daily reward can be Star Coins and Gems!
[/list]

[h2]New Sets in the Bank[/h2]

The Goblin Bank has also expanded its assortment and is ready to offer new items to the Braves:

[b]Daily Ether Prism Sets:[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 Ether Prisms
[/list]
[b]Daily Infinity Prism Sets:[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 Infinity Prisms
[/list]
[b]Monthly Prism Sets:[/b]
[list]
[*] 50 Ether Prisms
[*] 50 Infinity Prisms
[/list]
[b] Beginner's Set 1:[/b]
[list]
[*] 100 Gems
[*] 20,000 Gold Coins
[*] 10 Ether Prisms
[*] Rare hero Aerin
[/list]
[b]Beginner's Set 2:[/b]
[list]
[*] 200 Gems
[*] 50,000 Gold Coins
[*] 10 Infinity Prisms
[*] Epic rarity Sorcerer's Ring
[*] 30 Stone
[*] 30 Wood
[/list]
[b]Beginner's Set 3:[/b]
[list]
[*] 300 Gems
[*] 75,000 Gold Coins
[*] 20 Ether Prisms
[*] Epic rarity Sorcerer's Robe
[*] 40 random blueprints
[*] 40 Hero Manga volumes
[/list]
[b]Beginner's Set 4:[/b]
[list]
[*] 500 Gems
[*] 100,000 Gold Coins
[*] 10 Infinity Prisms
[*] 50 random runes
[*] Epic rarity Arsonist's Staff
[/list]
[b]Beginner's Set 5:[/b]
[list]
[*] 1,000 Gems
[*] 150,000 Gold Coins
[*] 30 Infinity Prisms
[*] Unique skin for rare hero Aerin - Exalted Aerin
[/list]
Please note that the new beginner sets must be purchased sequentially. To purchase set number 5, you will need to purchase the four previous sets first.

[h2]New Quests[/h2]

We haven't forgotten about quests for adventurers. The Town Hall now has two new quest chains for the new modes. Let's take a closer look at the new quest chains:
[b]Chase Mode Quest Chain:[/b]
[list]
[*] 29 new task groups
[*] Each group contains 5 tasks related to the new mode
[*] As rewards for completing them, you can receive Ether and Infinity Prisms, Gems, Hero Manga volumes, as well as gold coins!
[/list]

[b]Invasion Mode Quest Chain:[/b]
[list]
[*] 30 new task groups
[*] Each group contains 6 tasks related to the new mode
[*] As rewards for completing them, you can receive Ether and Infinity Prisms, Gems, construction materials, various runes for strengthening your heroes at the Academy, as well as gold coins!
[/list]
Go forth, meet adventure, and challenge the monster leaders and alien invaders. After all, only you can protect Singoru from the forces of evil!

[h2]Pity Counter[/h2]

Previously, the guarantee for obtaining a legendary hero or equipment item in Portals had to be tracked manually. Now we've implemented an automatic pity counter for the Portal building and event activities in the Market building!
This innovation will allow you to easily see how many summon attempts remain until guaranteed receipt of a legendary hero or equipment item, making the summoning process more convenient and transparent!

[h2]Resource Conversion for Gems[/h2]

Lacking resources to upgrade your favorite hero, construct buildings, or improve equipment levels? No problem! Now you can quickly and conveniently purchase missing resources for Gems. This will help you speed up progress and avoid long waits.

How to use it: Simply click the hero upgrade button in the Tavern building, even if you don't have enough Hero Manga volumes to upgrade the hero, and the game will automatically offer to purchase the missing resources for Gems.

Use this feature to make your gameplay even more comfortable and efficient!

[h2]Hero Rebalancing[/h2]

[h3]Dancing Flame:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Specialization "+2 to Fire Dragon level at match start" moved from Mythic to Epic rarity, also reduced value from 2 -> 1
[*] Added new Mythic rarity specialization increasing Fire Dragon and its evolution damage by 100%
[/list]

[h3]Elusive Ice:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Specialization "+2 to Ice Dragon level at match start" moved from Mythic to Epic rarity, also reduced value from 2 -> 1
[*] Added new Mythic rarity specialization increasing Ice Dragon and its evolution damage by 100%
[*] Changed conditions for transformation into dragon form - now occurs when dealing damage rather than receiving it as before.
[/list]
[h3]Antony - Flesh Tormentor:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cooldown time for "Blood Rain" specialization reduced from 45s -> 15s
[/list]

[h2]New Hero Skins[/h2]

Our heroes have received new skins, and some have gotten them for the first time:

[list]
[*] Dungeon Lord Bob Bonecrusher: +2.5% to attack
[*] Midnight Dungeon Princess: +2.5% to skill duration
[*] Captain Barrett: +1.25% to run speed
[*] Great Nameless Snake Mage Velikia: +0.7% to attack per 10 match levels
[*] Exalted Limuru: 2.5% chance to deal double damage
[*] Exalted Aerin: -2.5% to skill cooldown (can only be obtained by purchasing Beginner's Set 5)
[*] Earth Adept Stefan: 10% chance to restore 2% health when taking damage
[*] Mysterious Cat Tieme: -2.5% to skill cooldown
[*] Arrogant Diva Bastet: +1.25% to run speed
[*] Moon Guardian Riley: 2.5% chance for skill reactivation
[*] Virtuoso Mage Nailus: +0.7% to attack per 10 match levels
[*] Balance Servant Kaliz'k: +0.7% to health per 10 match levels
[*] Chef Terra: +2.5% to armor
[*] Wind Princess Sylpha: 2.75% chance to deal triple damage
[/list]
You can already find them in the Tavern and purchase them for Transformation Masks, Gems, Star Coins, or in the new Beginner's Set!

[h2]Opening of New Portals[/h2]

Do you hear the echoes of battle, brave ones? Ether waves bring new heroes to Singoru, and they definitely know how to win, even when outnumbered. Welcome [b]Battle Heroes Portal and Battle Artifacts Portal[/b]!
The Battle Heroes Portal features three new, unique heroes. What can they do? How will they surprise us? Let's take a look together:

[h3]Kaliz'k[/h3]
[i][b]Legendary Defense Hero.[/b][/i]

Once he loved bringing joy by giving gifts, but one day he lost everything and took the dark path of necromancy. After years, he's ready to give gifts again, though now they're meant for enemies who probably won't like them...
Let's look at his abilities:

[b]Legendary Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] -50% to Skeleton Summon and its evolution cooldown
[*] 2.5% chance to summon skeleton minion when killing an enemy
[*] 5% chance for festive chest instead of regular one. Festive chest can only contain bomb, magnet or time freeze
[*] +15% to health
[*] +100% to minion health
[*] +1 resurrection
[*] Fully restores health when resurrected
[*] +35% to Skeleton Summon and its evolution damage
[*] -7% to other weapons' damage
[*] +1 Skeleton Summon evolution level: Death Knight
[/list]
[b]Mythic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] +2 levels to Skeleton Summon at match start
[*] Summons 5 skeleton minions when resurrected
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/618b9a373ca973c265b482179eb24dbfe3db721e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/d0a3897257c070444d6a778d1ffd025778c4dc92.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Sylpha[/h3]
[i][b] Legendary Attack Hero.[/b][/i]
Perhaps somewhere between worlds awaits the answer - why she became the one with whom the wind speaks as an equal. But while it's in her hands and the sky is overhead, she continues her path. After all, you can't hold the wind - you can only fly with it.
While Sylpha floats in the clouds, let's look at her abilities:

[b]Legendary Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] Wind Bastion. When collecting ingredients, summons storm area dealing damage and reducing enemy movement and attack speed. Enemies in storm area are pushed from epicenter
[*] +20% to projectile speed
[*] +15% to run speed
[*] +100% to knockback force
[*] +0.3% to movement speed per percentage of missing health
[*] +20% to air skill area
[*] +35% to Air Elemental and its evolution damage
[*] -7% to other weapons' damage
[*] +1 Air Elemental evolution level: Storm Guardian
[*] Wind Blessing. When taking damage, receives Wind Blessing. Increases dodge by 15% for 3 seconds. 5 second cooldown
[/list]
[b]Mythic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] +2 to Air Elemental level at match start
[*] 10% chance for double air skill damage
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2fa186d81a5324f63fc4d82332abb33105aa33a7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/5b593d47af02961632c2f221e532670875e654d0.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Terra[/h3] [i][b]Epic Defense Heroine. [/b][/i]
A mysterious and talented magical sculptor whose hands can turn ordinary stone into living works of art. Her name, meaning "earth", perfectly reflects her connection to natural materials and earth magic. Terra can not only create monumental sculptures but breathe life into them, endowing them with magical power.
Let's take a closer look at this heroine:

[b]Epic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] +35% to Stone Golem and its evolution damage
[*] -7% to other weapons' damage
[*] +100% to item pickup radius
[*] +100% to minion health
[*] 1% chance to heal 1% health when picking up item or experience
[*] +15% to armor
[*] When dealing damage with earth skill, has chance to reduce enemy attack by 25% for 5 sec
[*] +20% to earth skill size
[/list]
[b]Legendary Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] +1 Stone Golem evolution level: Stone Guardian
[/list]
[b]Mythic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] When picking up item, summons Royal Golem. 5 sec cooldown
[*] +2 to Stone Golem level at match start
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/1bf0ba3d8b20bf737966e503d9947556b6ff6387.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/334de62bb367f75e0f8fcfd835d94ce82c3a4f5e.png[/img][/url]

[b]The Battle Artifacts Portal features three new, unique weapons. Welcome:[/b]

[h3]Lord of the Dead - Legendary Skeleton Summon[/h3]
[i][b]Gives the equipping hero the Skeleton Summon skill.[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] +30% to Skeleton Summon damage at Uncommon rarity
[*] +5% to all skills' damage at Rare rarity
[*] +1 to Skeleton Summon skill level at match start at Epic rarity
[*] +2 to number of skeletons
[*] +1 to Death Knight evolution level at Mythic rarity
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/4d515d96c041d670b7240911863b21f33ab58014.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/b58c8a21668b20ce7091008fca956466f67ff1ad.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Song of the Heavens - Legendary Air Elemental[/h3]
[i][b]Gives the equipping hero the Air Elemental skill. [/b][/i]
[list]
[*] +30% to Air Elemental damage at Uncommon rarity
[*] +5% to all skills' damage at Rare rarity
[*] +1 to Air Elemental skill level at match start at Epic rarity
[*] +2 to number of Air Elementals
[*] +1 to Storm Guardian evolution level at Mythic rarity
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/e0e6e5efa73e709c409960f984aa784337dc2a87.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/820b715e4fae5f66637ce7a31821d65ba1a475db.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Summoning Tablets - Legendary Stone Golem[/h3]
[i][b]Gives the equipping hero the Stone Golem skill.[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] +30% to Stone Golem damage at Uncommon rarity
[*] +5% to all skills' damage at Rare rarity
[*] +1 to Stone Golem skill level at match start at Epic rarity
[*] +1 to number of Stone Golems
[*] +1 to Stone Guardian evolution level at Mythic rarity
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2a9d5319c33db800f93054a15e6cab165c281755.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/167030d2da0ead416274235767d06a8a0704fbc4.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New Skills[/h2]

New heroes have come to Singoru, ushering in a new era of summoners. Fight side by side with new allies and protect Singoru from the forces of evil!
Let's take a closer look at them:

[list]
[*] [b]Stone Golem[/b]. Type: Attacking. Element: Earth. When activating the skill, a Stone Golem is summoned on the battlefield - a primal force of earth capable of crushing enemies with powerful blows that shake the ground.
[*] [b]Skeleton Summon[/b]. Type: Attacking. Element: Spirit. When activating the skill, a Skeleton Minion appears on the battlefield - a dark embodiment of forbidden magic, ready to follow its master's commands and fight enemies with sinister force.
[*] [b]Air Elemental[/b]. Type: Attacking. Element: Wind. When activating the skill, an Air Elemental appears on the battlefield - an entity embodied from pure air, ready to unleash powerful gusts of wind that sweep away everything in their path.
[*] [b]Stone Guardian[/b]. Type: Evolution. Element: Earth. Recipe: Stone Golem (level 8) + Repelling Minion (level 1). When evolving, a [b]Stone Guardian[/b] appears on the battlefield - a mighty golem created from ancient stones and minerals, possessing incredible durability and hurling huge rocks at its enemies.
[*] [b]Death Knight[/b]. Type: Evolution. Element: Spirit. Recipe: Skeleton Summon (level 8) + Many Minions (level 1). When evolving, a Death Knight appears on the battlefield - once a mighty warrior who fell in battles against monster hordes. His blows leave behind bloody pools that drain the life of enemies who dare stand where the fallen once stood.
[*] [b]Storm Guardian[/b]. Type: Evolution. Element: Wind. Recipe: Air Elemental (level 8) + Swift Minion (level 1). When evolving, a Storm Guardian appears on the battlefield - a majestic being imbued with the power of storms and winds. It can hurl spheres of air that rush toward enemies with incredible speed, dealing damage.
[/list]

The Braves' arsenal has also been supplemented with new passive skills to strengthen their minions:
[list]
[*] Mighty Minion (5 levels): Increases minion damage by 10% per level.
[*] Accelerated Minion (5 levels): Reduces Minion cooldown.
[*] First level - by 9%
[*] Second level - by 17%
[*] Third level - by 23%
[*] Fourth level - by 29%
[*] Fifth level - by 34%
[*] Healthy Minion (5 levels): Increases minion health by 10% per level.
[*] Many Minions (2 levels): Increases number of summoned minions by 1 per level.
[*] Swift Minion (5 levels): Increases minion movement speed by 10% per level.
[*] Repelling Minion (5 levels): Increases minion knockback force by 50% per level.
[/list]

But that's not all - old evolutions have also undergone some changes! We're happy to present their list:

[list]
[*] Earth Barrage. Type: Attacking. Element: Earth. Recipe: Stone Shrapnel (level 8) + Academic Record (level 1). Replaces Boulder evolution. Unleash a barrage of projectiles upon enemies that sweeps away everything in its path!
[*] Explosive Shards. Type: Attacking. Element: Water. Recipe: Frost Shards (level 8) + Piercing Strikes (level 1). Replaces Supernova evolution. An explosive ice projectile that flies behind and deals damage in explosion radius.
[*] Queen's Song. Type: Attacking. Element: Water. Recipe: Throwing Disc (level 8) + Hasty (level 1). By popular demand, we've added additional projectiles to this evolution, making it even deadlier for your enemies
[/list]

[h2]New Weapons[/h2]

New skills need new weapons, right? And these weapons have already been abundantly supplied to the vaults of all the evil bosses of Singoru and, of course, to the Eternal Soul Portal, Battle Heroes Portal and Battle Artifacts Portal. We present to you:

[h3]Herald of Bones[/h3][i][b]Gives the equipping hero the Skeleton Summon skill.[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] +25% to Skeleton Summon damage at Uncommon rarity
[*] +4% to all skills' damage at Rare rarity
[*] +1 to Skeleton Summon skill level at match start at Epic rarity
[*] +6% to all skills' damage at Legendary rarity
[*] +1 to Death Knight evolution level at Mythic rarity
[/list]
[h3]Harmony of Wind[/h3] [i][b]Gives the equipping hero the Air Elemental skill. [/b][/i]
[list]
[*] +25% to Air Elemental damage at Uncommon rarity
[*] +4% to all skills' damage at Rare rarity
[*] +1 to Air Elemental skill level at match start at Epic rarity
[*] +6% to all skills' damage at Legendary rarity
[*] +1 to Storm Guardian evolution level at Mythic rarity
[/list]
[h3]Mud Animator[/h3] [i][b]Gives the equipping hero the Stone Golem skill.[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] +25% to Stone Golem damage at Uncommon rarity
[*] +4% to all skills' damage at Rare rarity
[*] +1 to Stone Golem skill level at match start at Epic rarity
[*] +6% to all skills' damage at Legendary rarity
[*] +1 to Stone Guardian evolution level at Mythic rarity
[/list]

[h2]New Achievements[/h2]

New heroes - new achievements. For fans of expanding their profiles, both in-game and on STEAM, we've prepared 27 new achievements related to new heroes, modes and bosses!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ca6ed5eecf6cb219a48414d868e1190854b9e35e.png[/img]
Also, to celebrate the update, we've prepared a mysterious code for you: [b]windofchange[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/92ffd8a382c79233ad4bc5e19e50c850c013eaea.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ca6ed5eecf6cb219a48414d868e1190854b9e35e.png[/img]

That's all for now, Braves. We hope you'll appreciate the innovations! Stay with us, share your impressions of the game - we're always happy to hear feedback and make it even better!

notes.title: Developer Diary #26
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We're pleased to present a new installment of the "Developer Diary"!

For everyone eager to learn about the upcoming changes and innovations in the world of Singoru, we're ready to lift the veil of mystery. In this new issue, we'll discuss marketplace changes, a new marathon event, and new functionality!

[h2]Major Economic Changes[/h2]

We're delighted to present important changes that will make your gaming adventure even more exciting and rewarding. We always strive to ensure every game element is enjoyable and truly valuable to you. That's why we've reworked the prism shard system and prepared something special!

[h3]Prism Shards Convert to Star Coins![/h3]

After carefully analyzing your feedback, we've noted the impressive efficiency some players demonstrated in collecting prism shards. Unfortunately, the number of shards obtained significantly exceeded our expectations, creating some imbalance in the game economy.

We also noticed the current shard system was quite limited and didn't provide sufficient gameplay diversity. We want to offer you broader prospects and more varied uses for in-game currency.

Considering your comments that while obtaining resources for hero and weapon summoning is great, gameplay shouldn't be limited to just that, we've decided to implement major changes. We're phasing out prism shards and introducing a new currency - [b]Star Coins[/b].

In their place, we're introducing a more flexible system where Star Coins can be used to purchase a wide range of in-game items and opportunities. This will make gameplay more diverse and engaging, giving you more choices and progression options.

Coming soon:
[list]
[*] Exclusive cosmetic items!
[*] Valuable game resources - helping you progress faster!
[*] And much more - stay tuned for announcements!
[/list]
All your existing prism shards will be [b]automatically converted[/b] to the new currency - Star Coins at a [b]1:1 ratio[/b].

[h3]Temporary Changes to Star Coin Acquisition[/h3]

To ensure a smooth transition to the new system, we need to adjust market balance and drop rates for the new currency. Therefore, we're temporarily discontinuing prism shard rewards from hardcore mode.

But we've made sure you won't lose your favorite resource! Now you can earn Star Coins in the daily marathon - just log in every day to claim generous rewards!

[h3]Gift Marathon[/h3]

The "Gift Marathon" begins with the first monthly marathon lasting 28 days, after which it will transition to a cyclical format.

The marathon offers 28 days of continuous rewards. No quests needed - just log in daily to claim your bonuses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8ccdb2fe5a293256d3f5633b3e2bb3e8ce1753ce.png[/img]

After the initial phase, the marathon will cycle with changed rewards, while maintaining the same claiming system. This lets you plan your time and always know when to expect new gifts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/16f712f40007ff18daaf1ed2a85ae6ddd4c00012.png[/img]

Our well-designed reward system makes the marathon accessible to everyone. No complex conditions or special requirements - just play and claim your bonuses. For those wanting more, we've prepared a premium marathon track with additional rewards.

[h2]Evolution Skill Changes[/h2]

We've carefully reviewed all your feedback and suggestions. Thanks to your active participation and valuable comments, we've revamped several skills - and this is just the beginning!

[h3]Boulder → Earth Barrage[/h3]
[i](Stone Shrapnel Evolution)[/i]

Boulder has transformed into mighty Earth Barrage. This isn't just an upgrade - instead of a single hit, you now get a devastating volley of stone projectiles. Each shot becomes a hail of fragments, obliterating everything in its path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/404347557f9132d479814268f76199908d9ad78a.gif[/img]

[h3]Supernova → Explosive Shards[/h3]
[i](Ice Shards Evolution)[/i]

Supernova has become destructive Explosive Shards. This new ability takes the best from frost shards, but now each icy projectile explodes, engulfing enemies in cold and slowing their movements. Enemies don't just take damage - they're trapped in frost!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8577ab50f7ce05113504422f571ac084b87dea2b.gif[/img]

[h3]Queen's Song[/h3]
[i](Chakram Evolution)[/i]

Queen's Song has been reborn. The spell now hits enemies with multiple projectiles, creating a mesmerizing spectacle. The reworked visual effect turns the ability into a true performance, with each projectile dancing through the air before finding its target.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8018a2025cf361ec07e5fc896711799b054b7404.gif[/img]

[h2]New Aiming Mode[/h2]

The game now features flexible aiming settings.

[b]Auto-Aim[/b] - The classic mode where the game automatically helps target enemies. Perfect for dynamic combat and beginners.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/a1431e8bb4059b648fdd4b65a748aa1c9c666390.gif[/img]

[b]Cursor Aiming[/b] - An advanced mode offering full control over shots. You can now precisely aim using the cursor, especially valuable for experienced players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8ecba610a3435cf7c851684638ff456ac541aed0.gif[/img]

We've added a convenient toggle so you can choose your preferred aiming style. On PC, you have two options:
[list]
[*] During gameplay via a dedicated button (F).
[*] Through game settings.
[/list]
In the upcoming mobile version, aiming mode can only be changed through settings.
This new feature currently affects only certain skills:
[list]
[*] Stone Shrapnel
[*] Earth Barrage
[*] Crushing Blow
[*] Compass of Pain
[*] Thunder Arrows
[*] Arrow Storm
[*] Steel Fan
[/list]
The choice is yours! Customize aiming to match your playstyle. Remember: in cursor mode, accuracy depends entirely on your skill and experience.

Experiment with both modes to find what works best for you. You can change settings anytime during gameplay, so nothing stops you from enjoying convenient auto-aim until truly challenging moments when you might want to take full control!

notes.title: Developer Diary #25
notes.content:
Brave ones!

We are excited to present a new edition of the "Developer Diary"!

For all those eager to learn about the changes and innovations awaiting the world of Singor in the near future, we are ready to lift the veil of mystery. In this edition, we will discuss the focus weapons for each of the new heroes.

[h2]Scythe - Lord of the Dead[/h2]

When the world was young, and the concepts of life and death had not yet taken clear boundaries, the ancient gods of Darkness forged a scythe from shards of fading stars and bones of primordial beings. The artifact, named "Lord of the Dead," became an embodiment of primal balance - for every second life granted, it demanded immediate payment.

Kalizk acquired this scythe in the Temple of Eternal Silence, where it had rested for centuries on an altar made of skulls. As his fingers closed around the handle covered in ancient inscriptions, a whisper echoed in the silence: [i]"At last - a worthy Accountant..."[/i]. From that day on, a strange connection was established between them: the scythe did not merely serve him - it taught him, showing the true cost of disrupting the natural order.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/4d515d96c041d670b7240911863b21f33ab58014.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/b58c8a21668b20ce7091008fca956466f67ff1ad.png[/img][/url]

[i]"Do you think this is just a weapon?"[/i] - laughs the scythe in rare moments when it allows Kalizk to hear its voice. [i]"I am the scales on which death itself is weighed. And you are merely the pointer indicating measure."[/i]

[h2]Fan - Song of the Heavens[/h2]

In the mountains where clouds are born, an ancient fan woven from golden sunlight and cloud silk lay resting. When Sylph unfolded it, the golden spokes sang — and their song awakened slumbering elementals.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/e0e6e5efa73e709c409960f984aa784337dc2a87.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/820b715e4fae5f66637ce7a31821d65ba1a475db.png[/img][/url]

This artifact became her destiny. In battles, a single wave of the fan summoned whirlwind guardians, while the ringing of golden spokes called upon ancient storm spirits for aid. But with power came a price: after each battle, Sylph had to sing new songs to the wind — otherwise, patterns on the pristine silk began to fade, along with them disappeared trust from elementals.

[i]“We dance to the music of your heart,”[/i] — whisper the winds as they swirl around golden spokes. And as long as this song plays, Song of the Heavens will guard the valleys of Singor.

[h2]Tablets - Tablets of Summoning[/h2]

In sacred quarries where wind has polished rocks for centuries, earth priests found three gray tablets made from an unknown mineral. Smooth as polished river pebbles, they were covered with pulsating pink runes — a living language of Earth itself. Now these tablets are carried by Terra, mistress of stone depths, secured with a simple leather strap around her thigh. When she removes them and runs her fingers over the runes, a miracle occurs: Earth Elementals respond to her call.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2a9d5319c33db800f93054a15e6cab165c281755.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/167030d2da0ead416274235767d06a8a0704fbc4.png[/img][/url]

[i]"They are not tools,"[/i] - says Terra as she watches pink light dance on her palms. [i]"They are a contract etched in stone when the world was still young."[/i]

When she uses the tablets in battle, it seems as if Earth itself sings through her - a deep, powerful rumble that makes even mountain peaks tremble. And after battle, the tablets return to being just gray stones with dull inscriptions hanging peacefully at their mistress's waist.

Stay tuned for more exciting news ahead! In the meantime — share your impressions and expectations in the comments. Forward, Brave Warriors!

notes.title: Developer Diary #24
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We're pleased to present a new installment of the "Developer Diary"!

For all those eager to learn about the changes and innovations coming to the world of Singoru in the near future, we're ready to lift the veil of mystery. In this issue, we'll talk about a new hero and share updated information about a previously announced hero. And of course, we'll show mobile version screenshots.

[h2]New Hero: Sylph[/h2]

In a quiet village of the eastern Qin Empire lived a dancer named Xiao Fen.
Everything changed when a blind elder gave her a mysterious fan. At night, upon opening it, she felt a sharp pain in her chest, and her consciousness began to fade.

[i]"You won't die," whispered the wind to her, "You'll only sleep briefly."[/i]

The dancer's soul fell into a sweet slumber in the wind's embrace, swaying on the calm waves of the Aether.

During her sleep, the wind became part of her. The fan in her hands can direct whirlwinds, slicing off treetops. Air spirits will whisper warnings, deflecting enemy arrows, and in moments of mortal danger, fully merge with her, making her faster than thought.

Perhaps the fan chose her for a reason. Perhaps somewhere between worlds awaits the answer - why she became the one who speaks with the wind as an equal. But while the fan remains in her hands and the sky above her, she'll continue her journey. After all, you can't hold the wind - you can only fly with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2fa186d81a5324f63fc4d82332abb33105aa33a7.png[/img]

[h3]Hero skins: Fan Warrior[/h3]

When Singoru's monsters began hunting the "girl in white-blue silks," the wind gifted her a new form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/1de0e692b4c4c867b1ee05d2e198ebc8634d0179.png[/img]

In this form, every strike of her fan carries the fury of a storm. Most attacks remain ordinary, but sometimes - in moments when wind spirits fully merge with her - her attacks slice through enemies with triple force.

People whispered that what protected them now wasn't a girl, but the storm itself. And when at night a strange ringing sounded - like someone dragging a nail across a blade - monsters would glance around in fear.

For it meant a whirlwind was circling nearby... and the next strike might be their last.

[i]"It's not armor that makes a warrior," she would say, "but the ability to become invisible to blades."[/i]

And the wind, her faithful ally, always confirmed these words.

[h2]Additional Hero Information: Kalizk[/h2]

We previously [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2479830/view/4480612432780198344?l=english]introduced[/url] this hero, and since then his concept and abilities haven't changed drastically.

He can still summon loyal servants - skeletons - and resurrect in battle. In this issue, we'd like to talk about his skins, which will be added to the game with him in the upcoming update.

[h3]Kaliz'k - Servant of Balance[/h3]

Kaliz'k has become more than just a sorcerer - he has become a Servant of Balance. His once simple robes have transformed into majestic armor adorned with skulls. These are not mere decorations, but hints at the power Kaliz'k wields. His eyes, once lifeless, have now disappeared entirely - replaced by eternal blue flames.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/53c69df2532eebc52bba3985a1488f36ff78d4b7.png[/img]

But the most terrifying thing - he still gives gifts. Only now they're not toys, but eternal service in his dead army. On the winter solstice eve, Kaliz'k emerges from his ice castle, and those who meet him on the road receive a "gift" - a place in his endless procession of the dead.

If you see a blue glow in the blizzard - run. Run without looking back. For the Servant of Balance loves giving gifts... [i]especially to those who aren't expecting them.[/i]

[h2]Finally[/h2]

We've already shown much of the mobile interface's appearance. Next up is the "To Battle!" tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/0321dece1a5e09c602e532e7d09a68be28cb55a6.png[/img]

Stay tuned, as there's much more to come! For now - share your impressions and expectations in the comments. Onward, Brave Ones!

notes.title: Developer Diary #23
notes.content:
Brave Ones!  

We are pleased to present a new installment of the "Developer Diary"!  

For all those who crave knowledge about the changes and innovations awaiting the world of Singoru in the near future, we are ready to lift the veil of mystery. In this issue, we will talk about the second (in order but not in importance) game mode and new weapons. We’ll also share new screenshots of the mobile version of the game!  

[h2]New Mode: "Invasion"[/h2]  

Ready for a real challenge? We present the new [b]"Invasion"[/b] mode—dynamic, intense, and requiring not just strength but also strategy. This isn’t just additional content; it’s a full-fledged trial.  

[h3]Availability and Difficulty[/h3]  
This mode is available on all locations, but accessing it requires completing certain conditions in the normal and hardcore modes. For example, to unlock the "Easy" difficulty of the "Forest" location in the new mode, you’ll first need to clear the "Easy" difficulty in the "Graveyard" of the normal mode. But don’t worry—you won’t have to guess which stages and difficulties need to be cleared: the game provides hints to guide you!  

The difficulty levels in the new mode range from "Easy" to "Hellish." The higher the difficulty, the fiercer the enemies and the richer the rewards.  

But don’t be fooled by the name: even the "Easy" difficulty in the "Forest" location will prove to be a serious challenge—it’s comparable to "Hard" in the normal mode! So don’t expect to relax.  

[h3]New Gameplay: Race Against Time[/h3]  
The standard rules no longer apply—now every match becomes a special operation to eliminate the threat:  
At the start of the game, portals appear on the location—black stone structures pulsating with an alien purple energy. Their light doesn’t illuminate—it corrodes the mind, filling it with visions of inhuman landscapes and the whispers of ancient entities. The longer you look, the clearer you feel—something beyond the thin veil of reality has already noticed you. Are those voices in your head, or is it just the blood pounding in your temples?  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/c50f3b06c563dd6791db71f0b3782f7fcae3380a.png[/img]  

You have 5 minutes to destroy the portal and defeat its guardians—[i][b]Ethereal Hounds.[/b][/i]  

The higher the difficulty, the more stages there are: from one to three, each lasting 5 minutes. Fail to complete them in time? Defeat.  
Let’s take the "Easy" difficulty as an example: as soon as you spawn, a countdown timer starts. Portals appear on the map, and within the allotted 5 minutes per stage, you must destroy the creatures emerging from them. If the portals or the hounds aren’t destroyed by the time the clock runs out—defeat is inevitable.  

In this mode, it’s crucial not only to quickly eliminate enemies and portals but also to plan your route precisely to stop the invasion of the ancient gods in time!  

[h3]Who Are the Ethereal Hounds?[/h3]  
These aren’t just enemies—they are alien beings guarding the portals. They emerge in a blinding flash from the portals and attack without hesitation. Their goal is to stop you at any cost.  

The Ethereal Hound descends upon its prey in a whirlwind of lethal movements: its body seems designed for powerful lunges, and its claws slice through even the toughest armor. Beyond sheer physical strength, you must also beware of the slime it can spew if the fight transitions to long-range. And that’s far from all the tricks the Ethereal Hound has up its… sleeve.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/593a161109f0a044f963342ba153ef9d30fd0e3f.png[/img]  

[h3]The Final Showdown[/h3]  
If you manage to destroy the portals, at the end of each stage, you’ll face the location’s boss. This is the culmination of the trial—a test of endurance before the well-earned reward.  

[h3]Why Play "Invasion"?[/h3]  

[b]First, to protect Singoru![/b] The portal isn’t just an anomaly—it’s a gateway for invasion, through which the Ethereal Hounds enter the world. If left unchecked, the threat will spiral out of control. Every victory in this mode is a step toward saving the world from an extraterrestrial invasion.  

[b]And second… the rewards![/b]  
[list]  
[*] More construction materials;  
[*] More runes for the Academy;  
[*] A trial for true heroes—only the strongest can withstand this threat.  
[/list]  

[h2]New Weapon: "Harmony of the Wind"[/h2]  

The workshops of the Heavenly Stronghold still remember the story of the old master Liando, who was the first to "tame" the wind. He noticed that during autumn storms, spirits eagerly answered the call—as if nature itself sought to take form. After years of experimentation, the first fan-conduit was born, capable of summoning and commanding Air Elementals.  

At first glance, it’s just an ordinary fan, but it holds the power to command whirlwinds. No intricate carvings, no precious stones. Yet, its pattern carries a rhythm that mirrors the flow of air, and its rough wood holds the memory of forest storms.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/692e4a0fc8032e94ff8e2bbb50b13f15d9587033.png[/img]  

When a mage first unfolds it, the fan feels almost weightless in their palm—as if it might fly away at any moment. But with a single flick, the air before it comes alive, calling upon the power of the wind and the elementals bound to it.  

[h2]Finally[/h2]  

Last time, we showed you what the inventory and Tavern interfaces look like on mobile devices, the "Portal" tab, and shared new Field of View (FoV) settings to make your gameplay more comfortable and immersive. Today, we’d like to draw your attention to the "Forge" interface.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/bc03e0866beffe53c11d761cbfb9445d7984ecde.png[/img]  

Stay tuned, as there’s much more to come! For now—share your impressions and expectations in the comments. Onward, Brave Ones!

notes.title: Developer Diary #22
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We’re thrilled to present a new entry in the Developer Diary!

For those eager to learn about the upcoming changes in the world of Singoru, we’re lifting the veil of mystery. This issue delves into the Monster Lords of the new "Chase" Mode, alongside new minions and weapons!

[h2]New "Chase" Mode Bosses[/h2]

[h3]The Fungus Collector: Curse of the Mycelium[/h3]

In the Mycelium’s shadowy depths, legends whisper of a forager who became one with the forest. Once a man who dreamed only of finding the rarest mushroom, he learned too late: the Mycelium tolerates no thieves.

His final memory? The ecstasy of discovering a scarlet toadstool flecked with gold. As his fingers closed around its fleshy cap—a click in the silence. The mushroom was part of a vast parasitic network, and in an instant, millions of spores flooded his veins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/7cd5bb993829ace3fcc944db77e8a1e588873a9a.png[/img]
Now, he "harvests" with mushrooms bursting from his flesh. The Mycelium stitches his body with white threads—a walking incubator. His movements jerk between unnatural swaying and sudden lurches. When he pauses, bomb-mushrooms swell around him. Spores swarm the air; if prey stays distant, he hurls venomous caps.

The Mycelium left him just enough mind to comprehend his fate, but not enough to resist. In rare moments of clarity, he weeps—tears devoured by the hungry fungus. He is both warning and trap: living bait for those who dare forage this wood.

[h3]The Owl Queen: Frostcurse of the Ridge[/h3]

Majestic and terrifying, the Owl Queen rules the Ridge’s snowbound peaks, where winds howl like lost souls. Legends claim she is the Creator’s forsaken child, cast into mortality for defiance. Her form blends beauty and monstrosity: feminine grace, piercing blue eyes, and claws that shred flesh like paper.

Her mountain-leopard pelts are a mockery of mortals who shiver in the cold. Beneath the furs, her body is feathered in snow-white plumes that radiate cold. Her staff is no mere symbol—it summons winter’s fury.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/54713a8943b9a95b03fa4402d26af169d90db818.png[/img]
She greets travelers with a lethal game, twirling her staff to mesmerize before striking. Her attacks are cruelly elegant: hails of icicles, freezing whirlwinds, and breath that turns intruders into statues for her frozen gallery. Rumors say her palace holds dozens of ice-encased victims, faces locked in despair.

The Owl Queen is winter incarnate—merciless and unforgiving. If you hear the melodic chime of ice in the mountains… run. That’s her laughter.

[h2]New Weapon: Necromancer’s Staff[/h2]

This grim artifact is a staple of dark practitioners. A rope-wrapped wooden rod topped with a skull, its forehead branded by a blood-red pentagram. Dull crimson light flickers in its sockets—trapped souls stir within.

Such staves serve necromancers and witches as conduits to raise the dead. The more lives taken, the brighter the skull’s glow.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/0a83d50dfb16a7f946477cd347088f4159fc4408.png[/img]
A single strike on the ground cracks the earth, summoning skeletons—warriors, peasants, kings—all equal in undeath. Their bones creak; green fire burns in hollow eyes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/da9369e534bf68071765f4dad2d1b6c39c4ab283.png[/img]
But its true power awakens when soil is soaked in blood. Then, Skeleton Warriors rise—their scarred bones remember a thousand battles. Where they tread, poisoned blood pools.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2d053a11917c2677bf9ac85cdbeff70047b33791.png[/img]
Despite its crude appearance, the staff chills the bravest hearts: whispers of damned souls echo in its presence, and buried bones tremble at its approach. Spot a distant crimson glow at night? Turn back. A necromancer hunts nearby.

[h2]Final Notes[/h2]
Previously, we revealed the mobile inventory UI, the Portal tab, and new FoV settings for a more immersive experience. Today, we spotlight the Tavern interface.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/137a6f09ef4ac367b305ab506cb0df227a4ce334.png[/img]
Stay tuned—more awaits! Share your thoughts in the comments. Onward, Brave Ones!

notes.title: Developers' Diary #21
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We are pleased to present a new issue of the "Developers' Diary"!

For everyone eager to learn about the changes and innovations awaiting the world of Singoru in the near future, we are ready to lift the veil of secrecy. In this issue, we will continue to talk about the monster lords in the new "Chase" mode, as well as new summonable creatures and weapons!

[h2]New Bosses in the "Chase" Mode[/h2]

[h3]Brainiac:[/h3]

A living proof that even the most harmless experiment can spiral out of control. Once, this giant flying brain was part of the body of a not-so-bright mountain giant named Gromar. Gromar was famous for his strength, but his intellect left much to be desired. Mad scientists from a secret laboratory decided to conduct experiments on him to enhance his mental abilities. However, the result exceeded all expectations: along with an incredibly increased intellect, he developed powerful psionic abilities and, with the power of thought, transformed himself into something the inhabitants of the Laboratory called Brainiac.

Now, Brainiac is a huge flying brain surrounded by an aura of psionic energy. His single eye, left from the giant, glows with a cold purple light and is the source of his power. With it, Brainiac releases paralyzing rays, creates psionic storms, causes chaotic energy bursts, and emits rays of psionic energy around himself, crushing enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/88cd0bae48363a8833bca509ee21f64fcad8dac0.png[/img]
Brainiac is a creature that clearly demonstrates that science and experiments can lead to unpredictable and dangerous consequences. His psionic power and intellect make him a formidable opponent, and his origin adds a dark irony to his image. Encountering Brainiac is a test not only of physical strength but also of the ability to resist mind manipulation.

[h3]Sandstone:[/h3]

An animated dune inhabited by the soul of a powerful priest who once ruled these lands. In life, he was obsessed with power and glory, but after death, his spirit, unwilling to accept oblivion, found refuge in the desert sands.

Sandstone can sleep for centuries, satiated by the suffering of others, but once disturbed, he awakens, unleashing all his fury on the intruders. He slams into the ground, creating seismic waves, spits sand spears, releases clouds of poisonous gas or scarabs, and raises sandstorms, blinding and sweeping away everything in his path.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/a2c07154ec998b1e80ae13d5a34114c6cc7960c6.png[/img]
Sandstone is a living warning that even after death, ambitions can find a way to manifest. His destructive abilities make him a formidable opponent, and his story is a dark legend of the desert. Encountering Sandstone is a meeting with ancient evil that leaves nothing alive in its wake.

[h2]New Weapon: Mud Animator[/h2]

In the world of Singoru, where magic and nature are intertwined in an inseparable unity, the "Mud Animator" was created by an ancient order of mages known as the Stone Architects. This order was famous for its mastery of geomancy—the art of controlling earth and stone. The mages of the order studied the deep forces of the world to use them for creation and protection. One of their greatest achievements was the creation of tablets that allowed them to create beings from stones, clay, and even mud!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/014bb1f44f21155558fc801a1d8da01d8270fa63.png[/img]
These tablets, combined into a single artifact, allowed the mages to summon "Earth Golems." An ordinary golem created with the "Mud Animator" was a creature made of stone and mud, possessing incredible strength and endurance. Devoid of their own will, they faithfully served as protectors of their creators, crushing their enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/d4539b5b5df870eea3fdbd5b8e7f828947789cd6.png[/img]
However, there was also an improved version of the golem, known as the "Earth Colossus." This golem was more powerful than the Earth Golem, and its body was adorned with the same runic symbols as the tablets. The Earth Colossus not only had physical strength but also the rudiments of intelligence, allowing it to focus on the most dangerous enemies, hurling chunks of earth and stone torn from under its feet! Its awakening required a huge amount of magical energy, and therefore it was summoned only in moments of greatest danger.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/a03fd8ac0937f879c0a8fa2b7dd78ea5d68cf8ed.png[/img]

[h2]Finally[/h2]

Last time, we showed you what the inventory interface looks like on mobile devices and shared new field of view (FoV) settings that will make your gaming space more comfortable and immersive. Today, we want to draw your attention to the "Portal" interface.

Although the "Portal" interface has not undergone significant changes, we have tried to make it more intuitive and user-friendly. We have retained its recognizable style but added a few minor improvements that will make interacting with it even more enjoyable. For example, the controls have become more responsive, and the visual cues are now clearer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/51b098bc51341c0554842b4d6275ae184f9ddd73.jpg[/img]
We are confident that even such small changes will help you navigate the game world faster and enjoy the process. Stay with us to learn more about how we continue to improve your gaming experience!

notes.title: Dev Diary #20
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We are pleased to present a new issue of the "Developers' Diary"!

For everyone eager to learn about the changes and innovations awaiting the world of Singoru in the near future, we are ready to lift the veil of secrecy. In this issue, we will talk about a new game mechanic, a new permanent mode.

[h2]New Mechanic: Summoning Minions![/h2]

Get ready to meet one of the most large-scale and exciting mechanics that will fundamentally change the approach to strategy and tactics in the world of Singoru. Prepare to encounter a new force on the battlefield—minions! This mechanic will not only add depth to the gameplay but also open up new horizons for experimenting and combining your heroes' abilities in battle.

Coming soon to the game:
[list]
[*] Skeleton Warriors;
[*] Stone Golems;
[*] Air Elementals.
[/list]
[h3]Air Elemental and Its Evolutions[/h3]

Air Elementals will be among the first minions that the heroes of Singoru can summon to their aid:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/448f0720d59c42b55d3f0f06205a6cb850ca6b32.png[/img]
Isn't it adorable? However, don't be fooled by its appearance—this new companion will be very useful in battle! And by obtaining the necessary skills for its evolution, you can gain a truly powerful minion:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/6fa301c778923fb121ad2095e526256fd7c3915a.png[/img]

[h3]New Hero Type: Summoners[/h3]

With the introduction of the summoning mechanic, we plan to create a new hero type—Summoners, which means a new skill tree will appear in the Academy! These heroes will specialize in managing summons, enhancing them, and using them tactically.

To develop summoning-related abilities in the Academy, new runes will be added, which can be obtained by participating in matches. These runes will unlock unique upgrades and abilities for your heroes.

[h3]Passive Skills and Synergy with Existing Abilities[/h3]

But that's not all! Along with the new mechanic and new active abilities, passive skills will also appear in the game, which will enhance summoned creatures.
Additionally, some of the already familiar abilities will also interact with summons. For example, the Avatar of Darkness will now strengthen undead, making them even more formidable. Thus, the entire line of avatars will provide bonuses to summoned creatures of the same element.

[h3]Future Plans[/h3]

We don't plan to stop at three heroes and their abilities. In future updates, you can expect:
[list]
[*] New abilities that will open even more possibilities for combinations with summons.
[*] New heroes, each offering a unique playstyle.
[*] New weapons specifically designed to enhance summoners and their creatures.
[/list]
The summoning mechanic is not just an innovation—it's a new stage in the game's development. We strive to make the game even more diverse, strategically deep, and engaging. Prepare for your arsenal of tactics and strategies to expand significantly, and for each match to become even more dynamic and unpredictable.

[h2]New Mode: Chase[/h2]

We are preparing a series of new challenges for you—location modes. Similar to the already beloved Hardcore mode, new activities will gradually be introduced into the game. Each mode will specialize in a specific type of resource. For example, if you desperately need building materials for your base, it's better to choose one mode, and if you need Heroic Manga, then another. This way, you are guaranteed to receive the reward you need here and now.
So, you can start preparing for a new challenge that will test your courage, speed, and strategic thinking. Introducing the "Chase" mode—dynamic, intense, and full of unexpected twists!

[h3]Monsters Have Found Leaders[/h3]

Something incredible has happened in Singoru. Monsters, which previously acted chaotically, have suddenly united around the strongest. They have chosen leaders—powerful beings whom they now worship as deities. These leaders are not only smarter and stronger than their brethren but also possess a magical connection to ancient totems that grant them immortality.

Now, these monster leaders lead their hordes on hunts, and their target is you. But all is not lost! Even immortality has its weaknesses, and your task is to find and destroy the totems linked to the leader. Only then can you stop the chase and survive.

[h3]How Does the "Chase" Mode Work?[/h3]

From the very beginning of the match, an immortal monster leader will chase you. It cannot be killed in the usual way—it will pursue you until the totems linked to it are destroyed. But be careful: the monster won't just follow you. It will use its abilities to block paths, slow you down, or even call for reinforcements.

The main task is to act quickly. Explore the location, find the totems, and destroy them before the monster catches up to you. But remember: the enemy won't sit idly by! The longer you delay, the more dangerous the situation becomes.

[h3]Unique Enemies for Each Location[/h3]

We have tried to make each match in the "Chase" mode unique. Each location will have its own monster leader with special abilities and tactics.

Today, we want to show the enemy from the "Graveyard" location:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/96c148543443a86c07b94c7ed14f0286a6605548.png[/img]

In future diaries, other enemies will be gradually revealed, each representing a unique threat.

[h2]Finally[/h2]

In the previous issue, we lifted the veil on upcoming changes related to the release of the mobile version of the game. We mentioned an updated interface, cross-platform progression, and many other improvements that will make the game even more convenient and accessible. Today, we would like to show another important step in this direction—the new FoV (Field of View)!

We have tried to make the FoV as comfortable as possible for both mobile devices and PCs/consoles! Moreover, we plan to make it customizable, so each player can adjust it to their preferences and playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/67ee2650e3fad8c017a90e2ce9f64d710e20e748.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more news, as there is still a lot of exciting stuff ahead! In the meantime—share your impressions and expectations in the comments. Forward, Brave Ones!

notes.title: Dev's Diary #19
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We are pleased to present you with a new issue of the "Developers' Diary"!

For everyone who is eager to learn about the changes and innovations awaiting the world of Singoru, we are ready to lift the veil of secrecy.

First, we would like to briefly talk about everything that will soon await the game and you:
[list]
[*] New abilities: summoning creatures;
[*] New Heroes;
[*] Changes to match duration;
[*] Two new modes;
[*] Updates to Town Hall quests;
[*] New locations;
[*] Release on new platforms and crossplay functionality;
[*] Hero rebalancing;
[*] Ability rebalancing;
[*] New skins;
[*] In-game chat.
[/list]
Of course, we can't cover everything in one diary, so we recommend that you don't miss our future issues to learn more about what awaits you next!

In this issue, we will focus on one of the new heroes, changes to match duration, and the release on new platforms!

Well, let's not waste any more time!

[h2]New Hero: Terra[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/1bf0ba3d8b20bf737966e503d9947556b6ff6387.png[/img]

[b]Terra[/b] is a mysterious and talented magical sculptor whose hands can turn ordinary stone into living works of art. Her name, meaning "earth," perfectly reflects her connection to natural materials and earth magic. Terra has the ability not only to create monumental sculptures but also to breathe life into them, imbuing them with magical power. Her main and most powerful ally is the Royal Golem, a massive creature of stone and magic that she can summon in moments of greatest danger. This golem is not only her protector but also the embodiment of her creative genius, a symbol of her mastery over the earth element.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8fd690e6455686f9e2bea69359d76a3b86c5c87e.png[/img]

Terra possesses unique abilities that make her even more dangerous and resilient in battle. With a certain chance, when picking up items or gaining experience, she can heal herself, making her durable. Additionally, her earth-element attacks (including golem strikes) can weaken enemies, temporarily reducing their damage. This makes her not only a master of earth magic but also a tactician capable of controlling the flow of battle.

In addition, we would like to show you her appearance, which will be released alongside the hero:[b] Terra - the Cook.[/b] Having reached the pinnacle of mastery in sculpture, Terra decided to challenge herself in a new art—culinary. After all, cooking, like sculpting, requires inspiration, patience, and a fine sense of harmony. While her attempts to create a Gingerbread Golem have not yet been successful, she believes that one day her hands will be able to bring this sweet creation to life. For her, nothing is impossible when it comes to art—be it stone or dough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2a2a60750dc7b6849942fe18c02247c9c489a146.png[/img]

[h2]Changes to Match Duration[/h2]

In anticipation of upcoming updates and the release on new platforms, which we will talk about a bit later, we have decided to reduce the time you spend in matches. But don't worry—this won't affect the size of your rewards!

So, what exactly will change? These changes will affect all maps and difficulty levels in the normal mode:
[list]
[*] Easy difficulty can now be completed in just 5 minutes;
[*] Medium difficulty in 10 minutes;
[*] Hard, Impossible, and Hellish difficulties in 15 minutes!
[/list]
We are confident that these changes will make the gameplay even more dynamic and exciting.

[h2]Cross-Platform[/h2]

In the near future, we plan to release the game on mobile devices (Android/iOS), as well as on the following consoles:
[list]
[*] Nintendo Switch
[*] PlayStation 5
[*] PlayStation 4
[*] Xbox One S
[*] Xbox One X
[*] Xbox One
[/list]
Imagine: you're at a friend's place, and they only have a console. "No problem!" you say, logging into the game. No more "oh, my progress is on another device." You're like a superhero, always ready for battle, whether it's on PC, phone, or console.

And if you suddenly decide to play on the subway (why not?), the mobile version won't let you down either. Progress will be synchronized on your 101XP account, so you can level up even if your PC is sitting sadly at home.

Finally, we would like to show you one of the screenshots of the future mobile interface. Please note that this interface is not the final version and may be subject to change.

notes.title: New Year Gifts!
notes.content:
[h2]“Holiday Miracle” Gift Marathon![/h2]

Brave Ones!

The New Year is almost here, and for some, it might have already begun. To celebrate this wonderful holiday, we’re launching the “Holiday Miracle” Gift Marathon! It’s filled with delightful rewards that we hope will help you protect Singoru!

[h2]New Weapons[/h2]

Not only do the harsh cold and terrifying monsters come from the far north, but so do tools to fight them. You can acquire these weapons in the Market as random rewards by opening chests with Holiday Bells. What kind of weapons can you get? Let’s take a closer look:

[h3]Shredder[/h3] [b]Legendary Icicle Launcher[/b]
Equipping this grants your hero the [b]Frost Shards[/b] ability.
[list]
[*] +30% to Frost Shards damage and its evolution at uncommon rarity
[*] +15% to all ability damage at rare rarity
[*] +2 levels to Frost Shards ability at the start of a match at epic rarity
[*] +1 evolution level for the Supernova ability at legendary rarity
[*] Fires icy scythes to the left and right of the hero’s movement every 9.5 seconds at mythic rarity
[/list]

[h3]Tear of the Creator[/h3] [b]Legendary Faith Amplifier[/b]
Equipping this grants your hero the [b]Aura of Faith[/b] ability.
[list]
[*] +30% to Aura of Faith damage and its evolution at uncommon rarity
[*] +15% to all ability damage at rare rarity
[*] +2 levels to Aura of Faith ability at the start of a match at epic rarity
[*] +1 evolution level for the Wrath of God ability at legendary rarity
[*] Fires icy scythes to the left and right of the hero’s movement every 9.5 seconds at mythic rarity
[/list]

[h3]Polar Star[/h3] [b]Legendary Shuriken[/b]
Equipping this grants your hero the [b]Steel Fan[/b] ability.
[list]
[*] +30% to Steel Fan damage and its evolution at uncommon rarity
[*] +15% to all ability damage at rare rarity
[*] +2 levels to Steel Fan ability at the start of a match at epic rarity
[*] +1 evolution level for the Blade Dance ability at legendary rarity
[*] Fires icy scythes to the left and right of the hero’s movement every 9.5 seconds at mythic rarity
[/list]

Our moderators made a short video overview of the weapons to make it easier for you to understand how they perform in combat!
[previewyoutube=Nlz7qsPQ7Rg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Balance the Elite Bars![/h2]

We have listened to your feedback! The Elite Bars that have been causing so much trouble promise to behave better. Battles on the fields of Frost Harvest will now be more exciting and fairer. Thank you for your feedback, and good luck with your new adventures!
