notes.title: Abnormal Update
notes.content:
Brave ones!


We present to your attention the update of The Braves! We have a lot of news, big and small, so let's not waste time and find out what awaits you sooner!

[h1]New languages[/h1]

It's no secret that the brave speak the same language - the language of victory, but everyone also has a favorite language that they can choose from the game menu. For your convenience, we have added five more:
[list]
[*] Chinese (Traditional)
[*] Turkish
[*] Italian
[*] Thai 
[*] Indonesian
[/list]
In the near future, there will also be a voiceover for the launch video for these languages! 

[h1]New difficulty of Hardcore mode[/h1]

There was a rumor that some brave men had already overcome all the dangers they encountered on the path of adventure, and now they would face a new danger - a Hardcore mode of new, Abnormal complexity. What awaits you?
[list]
[*] [b]Bosses.[/b] Not only have they become angrier and gained new abilities, but their appearance has been redesigned to reflect the strange changes that are taking place in the world of Singoru.
[*] [b]Awards.[/b] The higher the difficulty, the sweeter the taste of victory. And what can make it even sweeter? Of course there is a reward. More resources. More gold. More equipment!
[*] [b]Tasks.[/b] The Hardcore tasks section has been updated with new chapters and new rewards. How fast will you be able to complete all the tasks?
[*] [b]Trials.[/b] Each match is a real battle, where you will need all your experience, courage and skill, because the Abnormal complexity of the Forest will be more difficult than the Extreme Bran! So go ahead, Brave Men!  
[/list]
[h1]Gaining experience in combat[/h1]

Thanks to your suggestions, brave men, we are introducing a new system for gaining experience. Now the heroes will be able to gain levels not only by reading volumes of heroic manga in the cozy walls of the tavern, but also by performing various feats. Send them into battle and watch their experience grow.

[h1]Improved Rewards[/h1]

There was a rumor that the rewards for the first 28 chapters of the regular regime had been increased in the Town Hall. They say that a mysterious patron wants to get rid of all the monsters as soon as possible.
In addition, the rewards that can be obtained by killing bosses and collecting points of interest in the light, medium and heavy Forest, as well as in the light Laboratory have been increased! This will help the brave men who not so long ago heard the call of Singor to gain strength faster in the fight against evil.

[h1]Guaranteed Legendary Summoning[/h1]

Great news for all the brave people! We have added a guaranteed legendary summoning feature to portals with heroes and weapons. Now every 50th summoning is guaranteed to be legendary! At the same time, if the legendary call happens before the guaranteed one, then the guarantor's counter will not go wrong! In the future, for your convenience, we will add a countdown to each portal so that you can see exactly when your guaranteed legendary summoning will be. 

[b]ATTENTION![/b] Each portal has its own counter. If the portal disappears, it disappears with its counter. But don't worry, the current of the ether waves can once again bring your favorite portal to the shores of Singoru.

[h1]Strengthening old heroes[/h1]

The characters, who have been familiar to everyone for a long time, learn new tricks and improve their skills. Thanks to the advanced training program of an old but very experienced tracker, druid Risha, the green-skinned warrior Bob Bonecrusher and the unstoppable berserker Iron Bjorn began to play with new colors on the battlefield becoming much stronger.

[b][h2]Risha[/h2][/b]
[h3]Epic Rarity[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hybrid forms. Now, as a true druid, she can take the hybrid forms of a Spriggan, a Wolf, a Leopard and a Bear immediately, without waiting for an increase in rarity! This greatly diversifies her playing style, allowing her to flexibly adapt to difficult situations.

[list]
[*] [b]Spriggan.[/b] With a chance to turn into a Spriggan for 10 seconds when picking up an item.

[list]
[*] +30% to projectile speed
[*] +2 to punching
[*] +25% to the skill size
[/list]
[*] [b]Wolf.[/b] With a chance to turn into a Wolf for 10 seconds when dealing damage to an opponent.

[list]
[*] +20% damage from all skills
[*] -30% to the rollback time of all skills
[/list]
[*] [b]Leopard.[/b] With a chance to turn into a Leopard for 10 seconds when taking damage.

[list]
[*] +25% to movement speed
[*] +35% chance of evading enemy attacks
[/list]
[*] [b]Bear.[/b] With a chance of turning into a Bear for 10 seconds upon receiving treatment.
[list]

[*] +35% armor
[*] +350% skill drop
[/list]
[/list]
[*] Gains the Accelerated Metabolism skill at the beginning of the match
[*] Receives a penalty of -30% damage from fire and spiritual skills. She is still a druid, so dark magic and fire magic are not held in high esteem by her.
[*] Receives a 5% speed penalty. Druids are used to walking slowly on their land, noticing the slightest changes in their surroundings.
[/list]


[h3]Legendary rarity [/h3]
[list]
[*] Advanced hybrid forms. By increasing the rarity of the Rishi, you will discover more advanced forms for transformation that will replace the existing ones.: 

[list]
[*] [b]Wild Spriggan.[/b] With a chance, it turns into a Wild Spriggan for 10 seconds when picking up an item.

[list]
[*] +50% to projectile speed
[*] +3 to punching
[*] +40% to the skill size
[/list]

[*] [b]A wild Bear.[/b] With a chance of turning into a Wild Bear for 10 seconds upon receiving treatment.

[list]
[*] +55% to armor
[*] +550% skill drop[/list]
[/list]
[*] The power of the Earth. + 15% damage from earth skills
[/list]

[h3]Mythical rarity[/h3]
[list]
[*] Advanced hybrid forms. By increasing the rarity of the Rishi, you will discover more advanced forms for transformation that will replace the existing ones.: 
[list]

[*] [b]A wild Leopard.[/b] With a chance to turn into a Wild Leopard for 10 seconds when taking damage.

[list]
[*] +35% movement speed
[*] +50% chance of evading enemy attacks
[/list]
[*] [b]A wild Wolf.[/b] With a chance to turn into a Wild Wolf for 10 seconds when dealing damage to an enemy.

[list]
[*] -50% of the rollback time of all skills
[*] +30% damage from all skills
[/list]
[/list]
[*] The Supreme Power of the Earth. + 30% damage from earth skills
[/list]


[h2]Bob Bonecrusher[/h2]

[h3]Epic Rarity[/h3]
[list]
[*] +35% to the damage of the Destructive Strike skill and its evolution
[*] -7% to the damage of other skills
[*] -25% to the rollback time of the Destructive Strike
[*] +25% to the duration of the Destructive Impact and its evolution
[*] +50% to the velocity of Destructive Impact projectiles
[*] The projectiles of the Destructive Impact and its evolution ricochet off the borders of the screen
[*] Projectiles of Destructive Impact and its evolution explode causing increased damage to everyone in the affected area
[*] Bob has removed a skill that increases the size of Destructive Impact projectiles and its evolution by 30%.
[/list]
[h3]Legendary rarity[/h3]
[list]
[*] +1 level of evolution of the Compass of Pain skill
[/list]
[h3]Mythical rarity[/h3]
[list]
[*] +2 skill levels Destructive Strike at the beginning of the match
[/list]

[h2]Iron Bjorn[/h2]

[h3]Legendary rarity[/h3]
[list]
[*] +10% to projectile speed
[*] -50% to non-physical skill damage
[*] +25% to armor
[*] +5% damage every 10 levels in the match (max +25% at level 50)
[*] +10% movement speed
[*] +1 to the level of a Devastating Blow at the beginning of the match
[*] +1 to the level of the Vortex of Blades at the beginning of the match
[*] +1 to the level of the Steel Fan at the beginning of the match
[*]Rage. With a chance to rage for 10 seconds when taking damage. In this state, Bjorn gains the following abilities:

[list]
[*] -30% of skill rollback time
[*] +40% to the size of all physical skills
[*] 1% chance to heal 1% of maximum health when dealing damage to an opponent
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Mythical rarity[/h2]
[list]
[*] -20% of physical skill rollback time
[*] +1 level of evolution of the Compass of Pain skill
[*] Bloody Rage. With a chance to go into a Bloody Rage for 10 seconds when taking damage.Blood Rage replaces ordinary rage. In this state, Bjorn gains the following abilities:
[list]
[*] -30% of skill rollback time
[*] +40% to the size of all physical skills
[*] 1% chance to heal 1% of maximum health when dealing damage to an opponent
[*] +0.2% of movement speed for every 1% of health lost
[*] +0.3% to the projectile speed for every 1% of health lost
[*] +0.7% physical Skill damage for every 1% health lost
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Opening of new portals[/h1]


The current of the ether has changed and new portals have replaced the old ones. Meet the Portal of the Icy Wind and the Portal of the Echo of War.
Three new, unique heroes are waiting for you in the Icewind Portal. Let's get to know them soon:
[olist]
[*] [h3][b]Tieme. [/b][/h3]

The legendary heroine. A mysterious ninja masterfully wielding weapons. Since childhood, she has been trained in the art of silent warfare and is now ready to take your side in the fight against evil. But what can she do?

[list]
[*] [u][b]Attacking Bombs.[/b][/u] Tieme knows when the enemy is most vulnerable and, when dealing damage, can throw 4 bombs around him, at a great distance, dealing damage and stunning ordinary enemies. Be careful, all bosses are immune to stun, but such a bomb will slow them down when hit.
[*] [u][b]Defensive Bombs.[/b][/u] When Tieme takes damage, she can throw 5 bombs around herself, in a small radius. Like Attacking Bombs, Defensive Bombs deal damage, stun ordinary enemies and slow down bosses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/9f80e8bb1871c931a952823c0f77d32b2dc1b4eb.png[/img]

[h3]Characteristics[/h3]

[list]
[*] +35% to the damage of the Steel Fan skill and its evolution
[*] -7% to the damage of other skills
[*] -25% to the rollback time of the Steel Fan skill
[*] +50% to the projectile speed of the Steel Fan and its evolution
[*] +1 level of Blade Dance skill evolution
[*] +5% to movement speed
[*] By upgrading Tieme to a mythical rarity, you will start each match with +2 skill level Steel Fan.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/9892a58278fd6e74ee94c693eb8e3d8522aceec6.png[/img]
[*] [h3][b]Granite Stefan.[/b][/h3]

A legendary Hero. A silent and stern earth caster. He doesn't really like to talk about his past, but he loves to destroy enemies with the power of the earth. With the gift of changing his shape, he can become almost invulnerable on the battlefield. Let's take a closer look at his skills:

[list]
[*] [u][b]The Stone Form.[/b][/u] Every time Stefan takes damage in battle, there is a chance that he will take a stone form. In this form, his movement speed decreases, but his armor index increases very much, as well as damage and the size of his earth skills. Be careful, this transformation takes a lot of effort, so you can use it no more than once every 20 seconds.
[/list]
[h3]Characteristics[/h3]

[list]
[*]+35% damage to the Ranger skill and its evolution
[*]-7% damage to other skills
[*]-50% to the time of the rollback of the skill of the Surveyor and its evolution. Be careful, the rollback time increases by 5% every 2 levels, up to 10. At level 10, the rollback time will be -25%.
[*]+10% armor
[*]-10% of movement speed
[*]+1 level of Earthquake skill evolution
[*]By upgrading Granite Stefan to a mythical rarity, you will start each match with a +2 skill level of the Surveyor
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2fb4bfec107d9ebc50d7933c7fbbd58ff83fec16.png[/img]
[*] [h3][b]Ice Jack.[/b][/h3]

An epic hero. Harsh and cold, like the magic that runs through his veins. Jack will stop at nothing in pursuit of his goal, even if he has to turn everyone who gets in his way into ice. I wonder what powers this hero has?

[list]
[*] [u][b]An icy Aura.[/b][/u] After dealing damage to an opponent, Jack activates an Icy Aura that deals damage and slows down all enemies in her kill zone. Moreover, aura damage doubles every 5 minutes of the match!
[*] [u][b]Buran.[/b][/u] When dealing damage, Jack has a chance to summon a Blizzard to the entire battlefield, which greatly slows down all opponents and deals damage to them for 5 seconds!
[/list]
[h3]Characteristics[/h3]

[list]
[*] +35% damage to the Ice Shards skill and its evolution
[*] -7% damage to other skills
[*] +150% to the power of Ice Shards dropping and their evolution
[*] By upgrading the Ice Jack to a legendary rarity, you will receive a +1 level of Supernova skill evolution.
[*] By upgrading the Ice Jack to a mythical rarity, you will start each match with +2 skill level Ice Shards
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/a33866cbc4f6299bb2029080a662bac65d37223e.png[/img]
[/olist]
[h1]Portals[/h1]

Three new, unique weapons are waiting for you in the Echo of War Portal. Meet me:
[olist]
[*] [h3][b]Moon Petal[/b] [/h3]

The legendary shuriken. Gives the hero who equipped him the ability to use a Steel Fan.

[h3]Characteristics[/h3]

[list]
[*] +30% damage to Steel Fan on unusual Rarity
[*] +5% damage to all skills on rare rarity
[*] +1 skill level Steel Fan at the beginning of the match on epic rarity
[*] +45% to the duration of the Steel Fan skill on legendary Rarity
[*] +1 level of Blade Dance skill evolution based on Mythical Rarity
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/c624c92e0c26375b6b08569127ea8e12cde86447.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] [h3][b]The Book of Cataclysm[/b][/h3]

The legendary folio. Gives the hero who equipped him the skill of a Surveyor

[h3]Characteristics[/h3]

[list]
[*] +30% to the damage of the Surveyor on an unusual rarity
[*] +5% damage to all skills on rare rarity
[*] +1 skill level of the Surveyor at the beginning of the match on epic rarity
[*] -40% to the time of the Boundary Marker rollback on the legendary rarity
[*] +1 level of Earthquake skill evolution on mythical Rarity
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/9d83e5785dec0b04b993c97620681b421a33e91a.png[/img]
[/list]
[*][h3][b]Cryogen[/b][/h3]

The legendary ice wand. Gives the hero who equipped him the ability to Ice Shards.

[h3]Characteristics[/h3]

[list]
[*] +30% damage to Ice Shards on unusual Rarity
[*] +5% damage to all skills on rare rarity
[*] +1 skill level Ice Shards at the beginning of the match on epic rarity
[*] +12% damage to the Ice Shards skill for every 10 levels gained in the match, on legendary rarity
[*] +1 level of Supernova skill evolution on Mythical Rarity
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/9d960311c7b377a46b74d60edd05107a0289a41f.png[/img]
[/list]
[/olist]

[h1]New achievements[/h1]

With the advent of new Hardcore challenges and new heroes, we have added new achievements to the game. Test your luck and skill and try to collect them all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/954b1d1d0775f8b5b2b52730d70230b91702f6c7.png[/img]

[h1]New Market Levels[/h1]

Rejoice, lovers of shopping! The mysterious Trader managed to find new supply channels and now the market level can be raised to 25, which means expanding the range and increasing the chance of finding rarer things on its shelves.

[h1]A hint on the market[/h1]

Many Brave Men have managed to accumulate a lot of resources in their travels now, for their convenience, when pointing at the shortened counter, the full amount will be shown.

[h1]Updated match statistics window[/h1]

Now the match statistics window will show the equipment and portrait of the hero you went to the match with. You will be able to share your achievements with friends and you will not have to waste time on long descriptions, everything will already be on the screenshot!

[h1]New boot screen[/h1]

Now, when you download The Braves, you can admire the new loading screen, where brave heroes rush to meet adventures! We really look forward to your feedback, how do you like this design style? Leave your comments, if you like it, then we will be happy to share it for your desktops!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/82fc33daf82f2fde42b963e3166479569049cb7a.jpg[/img]

[h1]The volume of the start video[/h1]

Now the volume of the start video depends on the volume settings in the game settings menu, and not the operating system volume settings menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2ba1c05deadce4858cbd98c54f59a8afe0599298.png[/img]

We hasten to inform you that this is not all that we have prepared for you, in the near future there will be another update that will rush from the frosty peaks.

The long-awaited Ridge is about to be in the game, so we recommend that you stock up, because soon you will have to hit the road!

Also, hurry up to enter a mystical code with pleasant gifts, in honor of the update: ANOMALOUS
Hurry up, it's valid until August 11th!

See you in the ice kingdom, heroes!

notes.title: Discounts before the Update
notes.content:

notes.title: Dev Diary #11 - Secrets under the Snow Cover
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

Welcome to the new issue of the Dev Diary! Today, we will tell you about the new monsters you will have to fight on the icy expanses of the Crest, a new useful feature for newly arrived heroes, and also show you the mysterious shadow of a stranger that has appeared in the expanses of our world.

We are pleased to announce that soon, in-game loading screens, you will see gameplay tips. You will be able to learn valuable tips that will help you unlock the secrets of this world.

But that's not all! During your travels through the Crest, you will come across the traces of fierce monsters. One of them may be the Armored Bear - a behemoth clad in impenetrable armor and possessing colossal power. Even the bravest warriors will think twice before challenging this untamed fury.

The next opponents you may encounter are the Penguin Saboteurs - the inhabitants of the Crest, ready to resort to any trick to defend their snowy domains. Having found deposits of bombs left by the mountain people in the icy caverns, they will not hesitate to use them, despite the risk of parting with their lives.

As you progress through the mountain peaks, you must be careful. Who knows under which snowdrift the remains of heroes lie who have lost their lives in the conquest of the Crest. Due to the curse placed on them by an ancient mage, they awaken from their sleep, sensing the living who pass by. And then nothing will stop their desire to satisfy their hunger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/f78b0973d086303f0dbfeb763e908b957b539f4e.png[/img]

And here is the mysterious silhouette that we managed to capture on the coast of Singoru. This enigmatic warrior is advancing towards our village. I wonder what abilities he will possess?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/aedeff9396aa4e0e1cdc9052d3bb54b0d924d179.png[/img]

We remind you that the Portals of the Grim Depths and the Sunken Treasures will soon become inaccessible. Be sure to summon the heroes you like, as they will disappear from the summons for some time. They will be replaced by three new heroes who will be no less attractive!

Don't miss the opportunity to summon the current heroes, as with the release of the update, they will become unavailable for summoning.

Our issue is coming to an end, don't forget to share your impressions and thoughts in the comments - it's very important for us!

notes.title: Dev Diary #11 - Change of plans
notes.content:
Brave Ones! We are glad to welcome you to the new issue of our developer diary!

Today we want to tell you about a change in our plans for the upcoming updates.

We know that everyone is excited about the new location - the Ridge. Climbing it is difficult and dangerous: creepy monsters, new mechanics and tactics and, of course, the unique beauty of snow-covered peaks of Singoru. For you to quite enjoy all this we need a little more time.

We have made the hard decision to move this wonderful location to the next update. We apologize for this delay and hope for your understanding. We promise that the update with the new location will be faster than usual.

And now a little bit about what is waiting for you in the next update:

[list]
[*] You asked - we do! Now it will be possible to raise the level of your heroes not only for gold coins and volumes of heroic manga, but also for battles on locations!
[*] We also heard your comments that you are already tired of playing on the same difficulty. Therefore, we are introducing an additional difficulty for Hardcore Mode. It will be called "Abnormal". Here you will be met with a greater variety of monsters and bosses with updated appearance, as well as generous rewards for killing them! We are sure that the game on the new difficulty will be able to challenge even the most skillful heroes and make the gameplay more interesting and diverse! And yes, the Abnormal Forest difficulty, will be harder than Extreme Bran!
[*] There will be new quests and achievements associated with completing the Hardcore Abnormal difficulty. They will be just as interesting as the battles!
[*] New portals with heroes and weapons will be added. In the update you will be able to meet three new heroes with unique mechanics and weapons at once! Each of them has their own set of skills to help them in overcoming difficulties on their way to the top and freeing Singora from the forces of darkness!
[*] We are actively working on balance. Changes will affect almost all heroes, and we promise that they will become more interesting and stronger, which will noticeably diversify and improve your gaming experience!
[/list]
Thank you for staying with us and providing feedback; it is crucial for us. You greatly help us with your reviews, motivating us to create more content to delight you!

Until our next meeting in our diaries, Brave Ones!

The Old Man traveling far from the scene along the edge of the forest thoughtfully looked at the horizon of mixed grasses. Who could be hiding in the sea of green? notes.title: Contest for the Best Guide!
notes.content:
Listen to the wind, Braves!

The Lone Old Man was walking down the overgrown slope in search of the fighting Braves when the ground rumbled and began to collapse beneath his feet. A desperate leap to the side avoided a ludicrous death - only clods of earth and rocks flew down in a torrent.

And almost instantly a girl's voice echoed with far from gentle expressions to the stretching man. A slender black-haired figure swept out and flew up on the stones to the very top. Graceful, flexible movements deftly twisted her body between the flying stones, two broad swords in her hands whirling up, knocking away the largest ones in her path.

No doubt the Old Man had met the Brave One, and a smile lit his lips, though his ears were bathed in torrents of scolding. Alas, like all true heroes, the girl named Fu Hao was too busy for idle chatter (fair reproaches do not count), and sent the Old Man to her faithful disciples for wisdom.

notes.title: Hardcore Update
notes.content:
Brave Ones, welcome the update that has brought many new features to Singoru!

[h2]Heroes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The X10 summon in the portal with the heroes of the current update now guarantees an equipment item or a hero of at least epic rarity!
[*] Annette, Anthony, The Mysterious Mr. S and their weapons, which were in the portals, are now unavailable, but don't be upset, they will definitely return! They have been replaced by three new brave champions with their unique weapons, who will help you save Singoru from the clutches of monsters. Meet the new heroes:

Limuru - a never-say-die girl whose body is made up of thousands of molecules, making her an incredibly flexible character, allowing you to pass through any obstacle and choose the best path to your goal. She brought with her a new weapon that matches her element - the Oyster, which will accurately fly out of her hands directly at the target!

Dave - an unusual pirate whose ship was washed ashore on the coast of Singoru, causing all the monsters to shudder at the sight of the invincible captain. His weapon and ally became the Junior Kraken - a living weapon that instills chilling terror in its enemies, which will strike down anyone who dares to stand in the way of its master.

Barret - a nimble and strong elf, whose fencing skills will make any warrior envious. His faithful companions in battle are the two sharpest blades - Honor and Valor. With their help, he, like a deadly whirlwind, disposes of all enemies who dare to block the path of the brave champion.

[*] Not going far from the topic of heroes, we hasten to inform you that the changes did not bypass the female half of our heroes. Now their bodies have acquired pleasant shapes, making them more feminine and attractive.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8591e76514c2f1bd851ef51cdec1e3797704a8cb.png[/img]
[h2]New Features in the World of Singoru:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The long-awaited daily and weekly rewards are finally in the game! Now, for the time spent in the best of worlds, you will receive gifts that will please each of you! Here is a list of the rewards you can receive: gold coins, gemstones, prism fragments, as well as full-fledged Ether and Eternity prisms.
[*] We also want to draw your attention to the fact that now, during technical work on the server, the corresponding notification will appear in the game, allowing you to plan your game activity in advance.
[*] A new resource has been added to the game - prism fragments. They are used to exchange for full Ether and Eternity Prisms. The exchange rate of prism fragments at the Bank is stable. This way you can exchange 100 fragments for one Ether Prism, or 200 fragments for one Eternity Prism. On the Market, you may come across a more profitable offer with a discount, don't forget to check the blueprints and resources tab with each market update!
[*] The "Hardcore" mode challenges the bravest and most experienced heroes. Only by overcoming incredible difficulties, they will be able to reach new heights in liberating the world of Singoru from the forces of evil.

This mode offers three difficulty levels:
[olist]
[*] Daring
[*] Brutal
[*] Extreme
[/olist]
In addition to gold and resources, successful completion of this mode will allow you to receive a valuable resource - prism fragments.

But that's not all, if you're lucky, you'll be able to get parts of the unique Conqueror armor set as a reward for killing bosses, which can only be found in this mode.

Matches will last only 15 minutes, regardless of the chosen difficulty and location.
Rewards for completing all stages of the mode will be much richer than for regular matches.
To successfully complete the match, choosing a favorite hero will no longer be enough. You will need to develop a whole strategy, paying close attention not only to the equipment, but also to the heroes themselves and their elemental abilities.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8591e76514c2f1bd851ef51cdec1e3797704a8cb.png[/img]
[h2]Buildings:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We haven't forgotten about the quests for adventurers. A new chain of quests for the new mode has appeared in the Town Hall. Go forward, to meet the adventures that will definitely captivate you.
[*] The buildings of our village have also undergone pleasant changes: the Town Hall, Tavern and Forge have received new levels for upgrades, now they can be upgraded up to level 25 maximum. Unfortunately, the maximum upgrade level for the Market remains unchanged, we apologize for this. But don't worry, in the upcoming updates we will definitely work on this moment!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8591e76514c2f1bd851ef51cdec1e3797704a8cb.png[/img]
[h2]Other Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have increased the maximum level for heroes, as well as added new "stars" to improve the characteristics of mythic items. This will allow you to create truly unique and powerful equipment sets.
[*] Now the maximum level for heroes of mythic rarity will be 125.
[*] Mythic weapons and armor will receive their own star levels, reaching a peak of 5 stars. Each star on your mythic equipment will increase the maximum level by 5 points, allowing you to cope with new dangers!
[*] The cost in gold and blueprints for upgrading mythic heroes, items and equipment was recalculated. The changes affected levels starting from 96 and above. The cost of upgrading items and heroes at these levels has been slightly increased. But don't worry, those who have already upgraded their mythic equipment to levels 95 and above will receive their resources back in full, according to the new prices.
[*] In addition, a comprehensive optimization of the game was carried out, improving its performance and smoothness even on less powerful devices.
[*] And the chance of equipment dropping in locations has become higher, now dressing up your heroes at the initial stage of the game will become even easier. The resistance of monsters to elements at high difficulty levels has also been increased. Points of interest will provide more in-match advantages, and the reward for killing a boss will be significantly increased.
[*] And 29 new achievements have been added to really challenge you!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8591e76514c2f1bd851ef51cdec1e3797704a8cb.png[/img]
[h2]Fixed Bugs:[/h2]
Many game bugs that you shared with us have been fixed. Now playing will become much more enjoyable!
Here are some of the bugs that were fixed in this version:
[olist]
[*] The bug was fixed where unusual rarity equipment could provide bonuses that did not match the item's description.
[*] The bug was fixed where Risha changed her appearance when picking up experience, not an item.
[*] The bug was fixed where the Lucky Set did not drop in matches.
[/olist]
[hr][/hr]

Also, in honor of the release of the update, we have prepared for you a new mystical code: [b]ENTERHARDCORE[/b]
Hurry, the mystical code will be available until 07/07 inclusive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/e9ab92e9f3216b33ce1d5585aa5e86a66b809db4.png[/img]

We hope that this update will make your game more exciting and interesting. We wish you success in conquering new heights!

notes.title: Results of the competition for the best guide
notes.content:
Heed Brave Ones of the world of Singoru!

The unreachable Nicola flares up for a moment in a multitude of dazzling flashes of searing lightning - and disappears into the darkness, for there are no living enemies left to behold his true face. A halo of mystery pursues the reclusive Brave, and his path entices only a few.

Nevertheless, behind the mask of mystery, detachment, and the fury of the all-consuming element lies the mind of a calculating and caring young man, single-handedly fighting against the Spawn of Darkness, plunging his opponents into an ocean of mighty storm clouds and electric discharges.

Few were able to share with the Old Man the knowledge of the path of the mighty Brave, but those who dared - told much, revealing the secrets of taming the fierce element and giving sound advice on subduing and unleashing divine retribution upon the heads of enemies.

The Old Man smiles, having come a step closer to the understanding of the wisdom of the World of Singoru and ready to share the reward with the heroes.

The winner in this battle of minds drumroll:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3265906901

The impending threat is great, the clouds are getting darker, the gusts of wind more severe. But today, the heart burns with courage and hope for a clear sky overhead. The darkest, gloomiest hour before the dawn - the wolf's hour, but it will also mark the imminent sunrise. And under the sun's rays, the world of Singoru dances!

notes.title: Legendary weekend
notes.content:
Brave Ones! Today, fate has prepared an incredible surprise for you at the very heart of the legendary Castle Bran!

Imagine as you make your way through the gloomy labyrinths of the ancient corridors, where danger may lurk around every corner. Your sharp and attentive gaze does not miss the slightest movement. Suddenly, in the depths of the darkness, you notice two red dots, watching your every action intently. In haste, you retreat to engage the castle's inhabitants in a more favorable location.

Thus, by the will of fate, your feet lead you to a vast hall. There, seated on the throne, majestically and at ease, sits Prince Vlad. He greets you with a question, asking if you would like to join his brilliant retinue. But you, not succumbing to his tricks and promises, boldly refuse and, flaring with righteous anger, rush into battle. The swift skirmish ends, and the world is freed from the tyranny of yet another monster. Approaching the throne where the prince sat, you notice a chest behind it.

With a heart beating in anticipation, you approach the chest and, holding your breath, open it. Before you lie the treasures, weapons, and armor celebrated in legends. This equipment will be a great help in the fight against the monsters that have flooded the world of Singoru.

This weekend, in the Castle Bran location, by defeating the bosses, you will be able to obtain Legendary equipment and weapons. This event applies to all difficulty levels of the Castle Bran location. The chances of obtaining Legendary gear will increase depending on the difficulty you choose and from boss to boss. So, by completing Castle Bran on Inferno difficulty, you will have the highest chances of obtaining legendary armor and weapons.

But don't waste time! This unique event is available only until Monday. So hurry to the sinister depths of Castle Bran and acquire the legendary power that will help you achieve the greatest feats!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ca6ed5eecf6cb219a48414d868e1190854b9e35e.png[/img]

Suddenly, a mysterious stranger, illuminated by a mysterious glow, appears in your path. His whispering voice utters the coveted words: [b]SORRYFORDELAY[/b]

You, as if enchanted, repeat these words after him, and your backpack noticeably becomes heavier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ca816a3823cf23b8ba9395af49600272bd234cee.png[/img]

We apologize for the delay in the release of the update. We are working hard to ensure that you can see it as soon as possible. Don't hesitate, brave heroes! This mysterios code will be active until Tuesday.

[h3][b]Important! Relog into the game for the updates to take effect![/b][/h3]

We thank you for your patience and wish you thrilling adventures!

In the boundless expanse of the world, there will always be those whose hearts burn with the bright flame of courage and valor. They are the true heroes who do not fear to stand in defense of the weak and confront the most formidable forces of darkness.

Brave souls, tempered in fierce battles, know no fear. They march ahead, leading those who have despaired and lost all hope. Their sword and shield, their strength and wisdom - these are what unite those who yearn for change. For wherever these fearless champions may venture, they are followed by a shining aura that dispels the gloom and fills the hearts of those around them with renewed resolve.

The aura that strengthens the Old Man's faith in the future of the world of Singoru. In his travels, he encountered a hero, shrouded in flashes and glimmers of mighty power, bringing death to the Abyss Spawns. notes.title: Results of the competition for the best guide
notes.content:
Brave ones of the world of Singoru!

When the mighty Aerin strides through the darkness, the heavens are illuminated by brilliant flashes, lighting her path. Tongues of flame rise around her, obeying her will, ready to incinerate any who dare to block her way. Each movement is imbued with grace and power, as if the very element of fire has taken form in this beautiful and merciless maiden.

Yet behind Aerin's stern demeanor lies a heart that burns with the desire to protect this world of Singoru from the forces of darkness. For she alone, born of the flame itself, can raise her voice and call upon the ancient Seneschal to erect an unbreakable barrier in the path of evil. And while not all may comprehend her unyielding spirit, a single glimpse of the embodiment of fury and might instills hope in the hearts of those who fight for freedom.

And the heart of the Old Man, when gazing upon the wisdom of the Braves who have walked the path of the great heroine, finds solace, for the world of Singoru gains with each passing moment the chance at a future where the descendants will reclaim the peace that was lost under the oppression of the Abyss Spawns.

The heart of the Old Man is at peace, and his hands find a reward for the worthy among those who walk the path to peace.

The ceremony honoring the Braves is hereby announced!

And now, the name of the courageous hero has been called: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199032822983] Mysterious Brave [/url] and his [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3260811083] guide[/url].

We want to note that the World of Singoru is so gracious that the consolation prize will soon be received by the brave ones who have accepted the will of the Old Man.

notes.title: Dev Diary #10 - Echoes of a Forgotten World: The Shattered Crystal of Balance
notes.content:
Welcome, Brave Ones!

In this issue of the Developer's Diary, we are ready to unveil the remarkable new additions that are about to arrive in Singoru.

First and foremost, behold these legendary blades - Honor and Valor. Crafted by a master blacksmith, they have remained sealed in the ancient halls of the Singoru world until a pure soul, called upon to protect the peace, discovered them. The sharpness of these blades can cut through even the strongest armor. You will be like a formidable whirlwind, delivering retribution on the battlefield and leaving only fallen enemies in your wake.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/1e92afac04633ad9792588d2b9e644924b9ca584.png[/img]

The next gift for the heroes is Ustrik, a unique weapon washed ashore by the untamed power of the water element. By placing it to your ear, you can hear the whispers of ancient waters and the cold calm of the ocean depths. However, not everyone can wield this marvel - only the chosen one, whose heart is pure, can comprehend the secrets hidden within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/90eae88b4e56f747072e8b174fe4846d2003f75b.png[/img]

And finally, the Junior Kraken - a living weapon charged with shards of ancient glaciers that hold the memory of a world not abandoned by the Creator. Hearing the call for help, it shook off its centuries-old slumber to protect the breath of life in Singoru.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/fe6b56674f4376921318053cb86d37bbafaa0bbe.png[/img]

The Creator entrusted the Singoru world to the caretakers - the Seneschals, giving them an artifact to help maintain the balance of the world. The stone tower that housed the "Crystal of Balance" reached high into the heavens and was hidden from the eyes of ordinary observers. But after the catastrophe, there was no one left to maintain the artifact's operation. Years passed, and the magic that protected the crystal slowly faded. One day, it began to pulsate, its flawless facets cracked, and the golden glow broke through the stone walls, illuminating the entire sky from horizon to horizon. And then a terrible thing happened: the "Crystal of Balance" exploded, releasing the energy hidden within it. The explosion was so powerful that the shards of the Crystal scattered throughout the world, like a meteor shower, bringing chaos and destruction. They struck all living beings, and only those who were under the protection of a sturdy roof and walls were able to survive. The shards, upon hitting the creatures, altered their very essence. Monsters, illuminated by golden veins pulsing in sync with their new, distorted nature, became the symbol of a new era in Singoru - an era of chaos, where every step can be the last, and every shadow a harbinger of demise. We want to introduce some of them to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/5c2097f3d27af6773de0163904c14dca63f2930f.png[/img]

Also, the maximum level for heroes of mythical rarity will now be 125. Moreover, mythical weapons and armor will also receive their own stars, reaching a maximum of 5 stars. Each star on your mythical equipment will increase the maximum level by 5 points, allowing you to overcome all challenges!

We remind you that the two current banners on the portal will soon become unavailable. Be sure to summon the heroes you fancy, as they will disappear from the summons for some time. They will be replaced by three new heroes that will be no less appealing!

Await the upcoming update, friends!

notes.title: Contest for the Best Guide!
notes.content:
Here it is, my wooden friend, the time has come to die. That's how it is when a hot, youthful impulse does not lead to new beginnings, but becomes the tomb of the Old Man.

We almost made it - the mighty creature was defeated, in the ugly rage of madness it traded its own hand for a hook that catches both souls and bodies. But a pack of rats swept in, and there were too many of them for us.

That beast is preparing to jump, in whose belly our ashes may find rest, and... I feel the foul breath. But what is this? Where does the soot and smoke come from? And these agonizing, yet sweet to me, squeals... for they belong to our executioners.

The Old Man opened his eyes. Before him is a beautiful creature casting balls of flame with a staff.
- What is your name?
- Aerin.
- I thank you for the wonderful rescue, I am in your debt, but I wish to multiply that debt.
- Speak, Old Man.
- Reveal to me, child, the gift of your great Wisdom, tell me about the power that scattered the invading enemies?
- Bah, ask someone else!
- Oh, what a nonsensical child, I do not ask this for myself!
- Others have walked my path, ask them, I do not care as long as there is at least one living creature of darkness left in this world!
- Well, then that is what I will do, since there is no other choice.

A contest is announced!

Condition: write a guide for the hero Aerin. Describe the pros and cons, highlight the most important gameplay aspects in your opinion - skill setups, equipment, synergy. Post the entry with the appropriate tag/title in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2479830/guides/]guides[/url] section.

Please attach the ID of your character to the text, you can find it in the settings menu. Entries without an ID will not be considered.

The deadline for submissions is June 8th at 19:00 UTC.

The winners will be announced on June 9th at the zenith.

notes.title: Sneak Peek #2 - Whispers of the Abyss
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

The mountain ranges respect only strength, those who are weak are lost. The Crest is home to strong-willed people, mighty beasts, and rage-filled Abyss creatures. But among all others, there is a beast that all other creatures fear. A dragon that has claimed the mountain peaks and bottomless caves as its home - an enemy to all living things.

All life dies under its breath, be it crimson blood or the Abyss-corrupted sludge. And it is this very arrogance that has corrupted the ancient being's soul. Now, the whispers of the Abyss have taken permanent residence in its mind, calling it down to the valleys - to destroy everything living. And only the death at the hands of the Brave Ones can free it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/115d50c9eec8059cc875d5ac817161aa47ca2c06.jpg[/img]

So, spread the word! Tell all the heroes what they will face in our [url=https://discord.gg/WTwtmrNedV]Discord channel[/url].

notes.title: Dev Diary #9 - The Endurance Test
notes.content:
Brave Ones! Welcome to the new edition of our Dev Diary!

Today, we want to tell you about an exciting new game mode - "Hardcore". Here, you will be challenged at a completely new level, and your gaming skills will undergo a true hardcore test. Monsters will be much stronger, but the rewards for their defeat will be much more pleasant! This mode will be a true challenge for the most experienced players.

In the new "Hardcore" mode, the duration of matches is limited to just 15 minutes, regardless of the chosen difficulty level, with a total of three for each location. Moreover, you will not encounter the usual bosses - the strongest and most malicious enemies will be waiting for you right from the start. They will be significantly more powerful, causing you much more trouble!

For successful completion of a match, the choice of your favorite hero will no longer be enough. You will need to develop a whole strategy, paying close attention not only to equipment, but also to the heroes themselves and their elemental abilities.

Successful completion of this mode will allow you to receive prism shards, which can be combined into full prisms and used to summon heroes or inventory items in the portal! But that's not all - if you're lucky, you can also receive parts of a unique armor set that can only be found in this mode as a reward for killing bosses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/198f9675ea46a5dae621f7cc090b014db68c22a4.jpg[/img]

Our team of developers has worked hard to create unique new monsters that will be encountered in the new location - the Spine. Among them are the Fierce Yeti, a snow giant fiercely guarding his domain, the Ice Golem, a mysterious colossus capable of freezing anyone with a glance, and the Mammoth Colossus, emerging from the icy depths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/0486e6886bd33e7f2e615db64136da5c9533bcbd.png[/img]

We are also pleased to announce that in the new update, female characters will acquire more feminine features. Their bodies will be modified, giving them a touch of tenderness and charm. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/e1117f7cf1056a5e2c0cdec7a295e805439de291.png[/img]

The current heroes available in the portal will become more valuable. With the update, they will be replaced by three new heroes, thereby increasing the rarity of heroes that can be obtained now. The same will happen with weapons. Each new hero will have their own unique weapon.

We look forward to the day when you, our brave heroes, step onto the new lands of Singoru to show your enemies your power! Until next time!

notes.title: Gifts for your love
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We are sincerely grateful to you for helping the world of Singoro grow! notes.content:
Brave Ones!

Today, we want to tell you about the new features that will soon appear in the new version of the game. A new hero, new monsters, as well as pleasant rewards for time spent in the game - we will tell you about all of this in this issue of the dev diary.

Let's start with our charming jelly guest - Limuru. Limuru is an unusual hero, she consists of thousands of molecules, which allows her to easily seep through any obstacle, giving her a huge tactical advantage in battle and, perhaps, reach places that were previously hidden from other heroes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/80d21eb403f7af6285d7e3128dfca5f0465ad89f.png[/img]

But it's not as simple as it seems. On the path of our agile heroine, new strong and ferocious enemies will stand.

Can you feel the deadly cold? These are the icy winds blowing from the top of the Ridge - a new location that will make you look at the world of Singoru... from a different angle. We are ready to lift the veil of mystery and show you several inhabitants of this doomed place.

Get ready, for soon the ancient ice will melt, and the path to the Ridge will be open.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/6847abb18050100ee3034f3cd6e16d581883ce99.png[/img]

And now the most interesting part! In the next update, you will be able to see daily and weekly rewards. Now, the time spent in the game will become another feat for you, for which you will definitely receive pleasant rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/828063c15d7ebb1c338f55c23cbdd13ef9bb7d13.jpg[/img]

Don't forget about our [url=https://discord.gg/PArdSmUVVk] Discord chanel[/url]. Join us, there you can chat with the developers, get answers to your questions, and simply have a good time.

That's all. Thank you for being with us, heroes. Enjoy your game!

notes.title: Welcome to The Braves!
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

Welcome to The Braves - a world of adventures and exciting trials. You've been waiting, we've been working hard, and now we are finally ready to present the full version of our game. Our game will continue to improve and expand, but for now, we are introducing what you can already see and experience!

First, we would like to present you with a promo code for valuable resources as a token of celebration. Hurry up and visit the goblin bank to enter the coveted code: [b]WELCOME[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/a3e5fe7450e3083074e3eb4d764e08918624b1c1.png[/img]

Introducing two new locations - Bran Castle and Sandy Dunes. There you will encounter hordes of bloodthirsty monsters ready to fight right now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/e3aeb8d987630d6c41c5cead5744f0417ffdd328.png[/img]

New locations always mean new enemies! Hordes of monsters and terrifying bosses will hinder the path to the long-awaited peace in the world of Singoru. Defeat them and get one step closer to unraveling the mystery of their appearance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/b1a0a079df75de42ed82d11732a141e580ac90c4.png[/img]

We have also prepared three new heroes who are capable of overcoming hordes of monsters. Antony, Annette, and mysterious Mister S. They are eager to bring freedom to the troubled world of Singoru.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/9234702644df9fbd5b97a1feeb9f63d678f04953.png[/img]

We have also improved the equipment. Now the selection of gear before battle will be much more interesting. Don't rush to put on armor pieces without thinking: depending on the rarity of the item and the set, they can now have completely different properties. And by wearing a full set of armor from one set, you will receive the blessing of the defenders of our world and become even stronger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/395fd075632acdb1d978f44a3b12e924f73bbb2e.png[/img]

Changes have also been made to familiar tasks. Battles will become more exciting, and the rewards for them even more pleasant. We have modified some tasks from the town hall, making them more transparent and engaging, significantly increasing the rewards and adding long-awaited achievements! Now, every defeated boss and successfully completed map will become your indisputable merits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/97d43bc9e2ed21f12a810c5728c1ab8722e4ec27.png[/img]

This is not all when it comes to our town. Merchants from out of town have started bringing new goods to our market that will be useful to everyone. You will be able to exchange resources and in-game currency for what you are currently lacking!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/4624b5dd15ac9945bd0262bc3ae91853701c8735.png[/img]

We have also updated the inn! Now, you can immediately see the hero's skills in his description. The hero upgrading interface has also been changed to make it clearer depending on how close you are to it and what new skills the hero will receive upon upgrading.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/b618a8586e8910440ac82f1289a1877fe8c12274.png[/img]

The city itself has also transformed: the environment has become more vivid, and hovering the mouse cursor over buildings is now accompanied by pleasant animations. We have tried to make our settlement even cozier so that everyone can find shelter for themselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/b9a3e88260bc75216c8034aed4191c80f4c884c8.png[/img]

Furthermore, the game has introduced a variety of new weapons that will definitely help you defeat the most formidable enemies. Heavy swords, magical staffs, and shurikens - all this and more is already waiting for you in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/971a6eda60a446ade8bf96beb2ab61f63f6cd201.png[/img]

In the portal, heroes of pure and eternal soul are already waiting for you, as well as eternal weapons - all of them can be temporarily obtained with an increased chance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/75d21404d0e027b17b2da67832d63255c695bd93.png[/img]

And we are also pleased to inform you that now you can play our game using a game controller. Due to numerous requests, such feature is now available in the game!

That's all, heroes. Hurry up and join the game, and share your impressions on our [url=https://discord.gg/gft4BQPM] Discord server[/url]. We will be happy to see your feedback. Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: Join our team!
notes.content:
Brave ones!

Do you enjoy watching The Braves' progress? Do you like our game and would you like to help it become even better?

Then we invite you to join the moderators team!

What are the moderator's responsibilities? Let's start with the fact that moderation is divided into two departments: content and general.

The general department focuses on communication with users, helping other players in difficult situations, and maintaining order in the communities. If you enjoy interacting with players and maintaining order, then this is the place for you.

The content department is responsible for creating posts and contests in our communities. If you enjoy writing texts, selecting the best works, and creating contests, then this department is for you.

What do you need to do to become a moderator? Here are a few simple requirements:
[list]
[*] Be over 14 years old;
[*] Express yourself fluently;
[*] Love computer games.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
Fill out [url=https://forms.gle/nsSJh1gQk2BgbiKS7] the form [/url] , and we will definitely contact you!

Good luck to you, heroes!

notes.title: Dev Diary #6 - Fierce Bjorn and the Denizens of Bran
notes.content:
Welcome to a new issue of the Dev Diary, Brave Ones!

Today we will tell you about the new inhabitants of Bran Castle, new mechanics for outfits, and a completely different side of the character of the old warrior Bjorn.

Let's start with the most interesting part! Soon you will need to think not only about which combination of skills to gather to defeat all the monsters, but also about which equipment suits your hero best. By equipping a full set of gear, your hero will receive a special bonus. Each set has its advantages, so choose them wisely according to the situation and your hero!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/e8b6223cf57f69ac5211ad122313007f6f043a36.png[/img]

We also can't leave you without bright novelties. Remember the fierce Bjorn? Now his fury has become more visualized. Right during the battle, this tough guy can go berserk and simply annihilate his enemies. Look at him, it's better not to cross his path on a narrow road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/e4ea5a7131d9b2a87ed89eaf8a92cf65aa2e858f.png[/img]

Our news also includes bloodthirsty enemies. Introducing the beautiful women of Bran Castle's owner, who will protect their beloved and the dynasty's home until the last breath. These ladies are so beautiful that they were able to charm Death itself, who is ready to fight alongside the heroes. Do you think Bjorn will be able to overcome each of these villains?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/52d4914e77a9475f82a8c9b3ad3168b78160b3e4.png[/img]

Our issue is coming to an end. We remind you that The Braves: Beginning will be closed on April 22nd at 14:00 UTC, and all progress will be reset. Those who have been with us from the very beginning and complete the training in the full version of the game will receive nice gifts that will definitely help you start your adventure confidently!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/a1e387f87e5f2010c734a5921ccef06265669233.png[/img]

See you later, heroes!

notes.title: Dev Diary #5 - Secrets of Development
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

In today's issue, we want to show you a new weapon that our heroes will be able to feel in their hands, as well as the developments of the well-known map - the main guide of the world of The Braves.

Let's start with our paper assistant. The map you see in the game now was not always like this. Initially, we conceived it as a mysterious scroll that would reveal its secrets only upon reaching important stages in your journey. We invite you to look at the map at the very beginning of its development. Which version speaks to you more?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/7217e5848d90c0a22e86a8dc21bdcebba28ef55a.png[/img]

And now it's time for the most exciting part! Look at the weapon capable of striking any enemy. Our blacksmith has created a true marvel of iron and magical stones.

You have the opportunity to try out an ancient relic that creates a barrier, causing damage to all evildoers nearby. The divine power in this artifact will awe anyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/5411d770c4001de7e0fb832b5db48d32a3253c59.png[/img]

We haven't forgotten those who love to test their skills in close combat. A magnificent sword made from rare metals will definitely make the battle special. Its blade will easily cut through any obstacles in your way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/edb05f6517a989b09c2eac96a86212e517f61aa8.png[/img]

We would also like to introduce a weapon for those who possess a strategic mind in battle. The enchanted bow of a true forest hunter will strike the heart of any enemy that catches your eye.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/7bd263fc2b952007114e9d3c4f67445b0032a81d.png[/img]

Our release for today is coming to an end. Until next time, heroes!

notes.title: DevDiary #4 - Sandy Dunes and Personal Assistant
notes.content:
Hello, Braves!

It's time for a new release of the Dev Diary, which means today we will share more secrets from the world of The Braves with you.

Today we want to show you some inhabitants of the sandy Dunes who are already preparing their weapons to attack you!

Ancient monsters have awakened from centuries-old slumber, so beware, as before you stand the patron of the necropolis - Anubis, and the Mystical Sphinx, the master of riddles! The battle with them will be legendary, and if you manage to defeat them, countless treasures await you buried beneath the sands of time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/00c0e21fbb4d95cc4fe13659d249f0220e0bfc10.png[/img]

Now it's time to meet the minions of the rulers of the Dunes. Even death cannot resist dark magic, and you will face not only ordinary decaying skeletons but also ancient king-priests who have retained their power. In these sands, you can encounter giant insects and creepy scarabs, but if you hear the hissing of hundreds of snakes, avert your gaze, as the gaze of the medusa can turn you into stone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/7c6c6d8d79495b0046ada6fea663ed5a89676686.png[/img]

We would also like to introduce you to a mysterious assistant who will be by your side from the very beginning of the game, providing valuable advice when you need it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/2fdba26ef93b39ea48e9334240dda710773b502c.png[/img]

We are also pleased to announce that we have prepared unique achievements for true warriors, which only the strongest and most tenacious can obtain! Among them, you will find achievements for defeating bosses, for defeating bosses under special conditions, for improving your armor, as well as for upgrading buildings in your village!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/20f01e3c379374b7de2efe41f198e195c781f399.png[/img]
Important information! We remind you that soon the full version of our game will be released, which means that The Braves: Beginning will be closed, and the whole gameplay will be updated. Don't be alarmed or upset! For everyone who has played The Braves: Beginning and completes the training in the full version of the game, we have prepared pleasant prizes as a token of gratitude for your loyalty!
[hr][/hr]
That's all for now. Very soon we will be able to meet you in the full version of the game, stay with us, we will be very happy to see you!

notes.title: Dev Diary #3 - Our Village is Growing!
notes.content:
Welcome, Brave Ones!

Today in the Dev Diary, we want to showcase unique weapons created by true masters specifically for the best warriors and spellcasters. In addition, new residents are gradually gathering in the town that you will wisely lead! Interested in details? Then read on to the end.
[hr][/hr]
So, let's start with those who will populate our town and work together with you to achieve its prosperity. Meet two travelers ready to become an integral part of the world of The Braves - the Mysterious Trader, the Dwarven Blacksmith, and the dignified Geese. Their true names are currently hidden behind a veil of secrecy, but we believe that you will be able to solve this mystery. What do you think our mysterious guests are called?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/a8ebdcbe50c1d3e157fe468b71643498776a84d0.png[/img]
Let's move on to the most exciting part - the arsenal. Waves of ether bring truly wonderful works of art into our world - new powerful weapons. For those who choose the path of a sorcerer, a staff crafted from pure crystal and infused with ancient magic will become a priceless treasure, as well as an amazing sphere exuding dark magic, but with secret inscriptions on its facets that allow one to control the souls of enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/b511bc9bb082b3a643d921e9db11d1d515912970.png[/img]
And for heroes who prefer to work more with their muscles, a special close combat weapon will appear, forged from rare alloys and studded with magic-filled precious stones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/971a6eda60a446ade8bf96beb2ab61f63f6cd201.png[/img]
Even the bravest hero will face challenges if they go into battle with just one weapon. We proudly present to you our new unique armor.Feel like a true traveler between worlds and gain experience faster by wearing the Set of a Guest from Another World!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/3cfecf3a8157990b9002e818b393834e4cf57924.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
This concludes today's issue! We look forward to your ideas and suggestions in our [url=https://discord.gg/Wp6a7DqFCU] Discord channel! [/url]

Until next time, Brave Ones!

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 - Castle Bran is approaching!
notes.content:
Greetings, Brave Ones!

In this Dev Diary installment, we are lifting the veil of secrecy and introducing a new location that will soon become available - Castle Bran.

Ancient tapestries and portraits conceal the terrible secret of its owners. In the spacious halls and dark corners of Bran, there has always been an underground struggle. But for many years now, one dynasty has ruled this place. Rumor has it that its members can miraculously preserve their youth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/e31b5d7d9e1f762d423334fcd41504dd07515457.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/9bec580b64ed9cec271c1f5bb3b2142cfc644417.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/9a2cba7f553fa18566829bd8a432b70da8ed6037.png[/img] 

For many years, Castle Bran has become a symbol of prosperity, but recently it was discovered that the residents of entire villages have disappeared. All traces led to this place, but where could all these people have gone? What are those marks visible on the floor? And where did all these vile creatures come from?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/f8b85dfa0ec744ccc368d3978ccc8fd1d45e777b.png[/img]

Many rooms of the castle are filled with forbidden books containing cursed knowledge, traces of inhuman tortures and experiments. The air is filled with the smell of evil and decadence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/7e2b955aeae0e04b8c32dcf99847df452045b05f.png[/img]

Do you already feel the goosebumps? We are confident that the battles within the walls of Bran will bring you plenty of unforgettable emotions! Stay with us, follow the news, and get ready to discover new secrets on the pages of our diary.

notes.title: Dev Diary #1: Release is Approaching!
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We know that many of you are curious about what our team is diligently working on, and we have decided to launch a weekly developer's diary so that the most curious among you can peek into the future!

So, what new features await you in the upcoming update?

[list]
[*] Launch of a new Asian server.

Some players from the Asian region may have encountered issues that significantly worsened the gaming experience. For their convenience, we are launching a new server that will provide excellent connection quality, minimizing or even eliminating disruptions. We want every brave one to be able to join the battle and test their skills!

[*] New building: Market.

You asked, and we obey! The long-awaited market will soon open its doors to you. Exchange weapons and equipment for heroes, as well as resources to upgrade the base. Now you will have a place to spend your gold!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/6fcd097a7a1ef7ecb5aeb821f8f4dcd3e4651635.gif[/img]

[*] Gameplay update in the Forest.

Brave ones should not stand still, and we have taught some monsters new tricks, all to keep you from getting bored!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/03144348ae07e464d94fcbe8c7974487acc28aa7.png[/img]

[*]New skill and its evolution.

Feel like a master shinobi with a new skill and unleash deadly shurikens on enemies!

[*]Update of specializations for multiple heroes at once:

- Cursed souls under Damian's command will be able to target nearby enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/69772ac7688369a095280940eada8a45d0629130.png[/img]

- Warrior Fu Hao will learn a trick that will allow her to effectively dodge enemy attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/d16476f0462e6f564e4508a93389a28978198b99.gif[/img]

- Vera Solaria will create an impenetrable shield that completely absorbs enemy damage, like real paladins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/abf69594e2764f69756f03c01dd13b850f2cbb26.gif[/img]

And that's not all, we have left something interesting under the veil of mystery!
Follow our news on Steam and [url=https://discord.gg/qMW5Buv6Sq] Discord [/url]  to find out what awaits you, first and foremost!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725213/ec06b7f3ddf69c56d87d76ab267aaf9b1ae3552d.png[/img]
[/list]

notes.title: See you in April, heroes!
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

As some of you may have noticed, the release of the full version of the game The Braves is being postponed to April.

We have read all your feedback and thanks to it, we have planned a huge number of improvements and additions! For example, your comments about the similarity of the heroes did not go unnoticed. We are actively working to create a unique gaming experience for each of them. A good example of what awaits you can be the existing heroes: Truffaldino, Risha, Jeannette, Alister, and the Great Nameless. Each of them will have unique abilities, making the gameplay even more exciting and engaging! For instance, remember the two dragon tamers? They turned out to be not as simple as it might seem! Ancient blood flows in their veins, allowing them to transform right in the midst of battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/6bdafd8528a8e8113f7fa2f2073e0971a3702bb0.png[/img]

Speaking of enemies, a global update for them is in progress! New mechanics, attacks, and properties will be added to familiar enemies, as well as dozens of new opponents on new maps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/d7ac897ec3bff94304638188012bd6b50b9d2f9b.png[/img]

Furthermore, in the game, new skills will be introduced, and existing ones will be improved. For those who missed the latest update or have not yet received heroes with updated abilities, we have prepared a small presentation, hurry to watch the video:

[previewyoutube=MhqocOd4guk;full]here will be the video[/previewyoutube]

We are making every effort to make the game more exciting and unique, so your feedback is very important to us. This way, we will understand which direction to move in, so don't forget to leave your feedback on our social networks!
[hr][/hr]
In addition, we want to thank our loyal players. All the heroes who embarked on adventures in The Braves: Beginning will receive pleasant bonuses on their game accounts in The Braves.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Heroes of The Braves! We are excited to announce an update to the demo version of the game, which includes significant changes.

The character rarity system has been reworked. Now, there are no Uncommon rarity heroes in the game, but a Mythical rarity has been added.
The differences between heroes have become more pronounced. Each hero has unique properties that change the gameplay style.

Changelist:

[olist]
[*] Increased overall game dynamics: the speed of heroes and monsters has increased, cooldown times for abilities have been reduced, and experience is gained more quickly. 
[*] Decreased difficulty: Forest (medium), Laboratory (easy, medium), and Graveyard (easy).
[*] The names of all active abilities have been changed. Now, weapons and the abilities they grant have different names.
[*] New skill evolutions added: Great Boundary-Maker (evolution of Stone Shrapnel), Pain Compass (evolution of Destructive Strike), and Queen's Song (evolution of Throwing Disc).
[*] Fixed a bug where acquiring a skill during level up and from a chest happened simultaneously.
[*] Changes to characters and their specializations:
[/olist]
[list]
[*] Liana
Rare: +1 resurrection per match, 10% reduction in skill cooldown time
Epic: +25% to experience gained
Legendary: +15% to the speed of Fireball projectiles
Mythical: +5% to skill duration at levels 10, 20, 30, 40, 50
[/list]
[list]
[*] Solaria
Rare: +35% to the damage of Faith Throw and its evolutions, +75% to the projectile speed of Faith Throw, +50% to the size of Faith Throw projectiles, +2 penetrations of Faith Throw
Epic: +2 projectiles of Faith Throw and its evolutions
Legendary: +1 level of evolution to Charge!
Mythical: +2 Faith Throws at the start of the match
[/list]
[list]
[*] Aerin
Rare: +35% to the damage of fireballs, +2 fireball projectiles
Epic: -40% to the cooldown time of fireballs
Legendary: +1 level of evolution to Pocket Sun
Mythical: +2 levels of fireballs at the start of the match
[/list]
[list]
[*] Damian
Rare: +35% to the damage of Cursed Souls and its evolutions, +50% to the speed of Cursed Souls projectiles, -15% to the cooldown time of Cursed Souls
Epic: +100% duration of Cursed Souls and its evolutions
Legendary: +1 level of evolution to Chain Reaction
Mythical: +2 levels of Cursed Souls at the start of the match
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fu Hao
Rare: +35% to the damage of Blade Whirlwind and its evolutions, +1 Blade Whirlwind projectile
Epic: +1 Blade Whirlwind projectile and its evolutions
Legendary: +1 level of evolution to Blood Harvest
Mythical: +2 levels of Blade Whirlwind at the start of the match
[/list]
[list]
[*] Zina
Rare: +35% to the damage of Throwing Disc and its evolutions, -15% to the cooldown time of Throwing Disc, +50% to the duration of Throwing Disc
Epic: +0.75 to the knockback of Throwing Disc and its evolutions
Legendary: +1 level of evolution to Queen's Song
Mythical: +2 levels of Throwing Disc at the start of the match
[/list]
[list]
[*] Nikolai
Rare: +35% to the damage of Lightning Strike and its evolutions, -15% to the cooldown time of Lightning Strike
Epic: +50% to the size of Lightning Strike and its evolutions
Legendary: +1 level of evolution to Over 9000
Mythical: +2 levels of Lightning Strike at the start of the match
[/list]
[list]
[*] Wilhelm
Epic: +35% to the damage of Thunder Arrows, Thunder Arrow projectiles and their evolutions ricochet off the screen edges
Legendary: +1 level of evolution to Rapid-Fire
Mythical: +2 levels of Thunder Arrows at the start of the match
[/list]
[list]
[*] Sister Remoria
Epic: +35% to the damage of the Aura of Faith and its evolution, +40% to the size of the Aura of Faith, -40% to the cooldown of the Aura of Faith and its evolution
Legendary: +1 level of evolution to God's Wrath
Mythical: +2 levels of Aura of Faith at the beginning of the match
[/list]
[list]
[*] Bob Bonebreaker
Epic: +35% to the damage of the Destructive Strike and its evolution, -25% to the cooldown of the Destructive Strike, +25% to the speed of the Destructive Strike projectile, +40% to the size of the Destructive Strike and its evolution
Legendary: +1 level of evolution to the Pain Compass
Mythical: +2 levels of Destructive Strike at the beginning of the match
[/list]
[list]
[*] Midnight Witch
Epic: +35% to the damage of the Unholy Barrier and its evolution, +1 projectile of the Unholy Barrier, +30% to the size of the Unholy Barrier and its evolution, +1 to the radius of the Unholy Barrier and its evolution
Legendary: +1 level of evolution to You Shall Not Pass!
Mythical: +2 levels of Unholy Barrier at the beginning of the match
[/list]
[list]
[*] Jabir
Legendary: +35% to the damage of the Burning Flame and its evolution, +100% to the size of the Burning Flame, -0.15 sec to the damage period of the Burning Flame and its evolution, +1 level of evolution to Dragon Fire
Mythical: +2 levels of Burning Flame at the beginning of the match
[/list]
[list]
[*] Truffaldino
Epic: -25% to cooldown while moving, +150% to pick-up radius, +100% to pick-up speed, picking up experience has a 1.5% chance to deal 500% attack damage to all enemies
Legendary: picking up experience increases the explosion chance to 3% and deals 1500% attack damage to all enemies
Mythical: healing when picking up experience from maximum health
[/list]
[list]
[*] Great Nameless
Legendary: damage increases by 0.5% for each percent of missing health, +1 level of Cursed Souls at the beginning of the match, +1 level of Unholy Barrier at the beginning of the match, +25% spiritual damage, +50% to the speed of spiritual skill projectiles
Mythical: +1 resurrection for each evolution of a spiritual skill
[/list]
[list]
[*] Alistair
Legendary: +5% to the area of effect of skills every 10 levels, +1 projectile, +10% to the area of effect of fire skills, +20% fire damage
Mythical: +15% to experience gained, +40% to experience drop from monsters
[/list]
[list]
[*] Slick Dave
Epic: +15% to maximum health, +2 penetrations with all skills, +15% to damage for each existing water skill, +5% to movement speed for each existing water skill
Legendary: +50% to the speed of water skill projectiles
Mythical: -1 sec to health regeneration period for each taken water skill, +1 level of Accelerated Metabolism at the beginning of the match
Notes: hero changes are not final, the hero will be reworked in future updates
[/list]

We look forward to your feedback on the update in our discord channel. Send us your feedback and share your impressions!
